-- The moba controls, as mod code. The page forwards raw input and this file decides what it means.
--   on_action("setup", args)   the page's UI data (args.ui: moba_ui.json) and the local seat (args.player)
--   on_action("key", args)     a key event of the local seat: args = {key, phase = "down" | "up", shift, ctrl, alt,
--                              meta, world = {x, z}}. key is lowercase ("space" for the space bar); world is the
--                              ground under the pointer.
--   on_action("pointer", args) a ground event of any seat: args = {player, kind, x, y, button}
--   on_action("select", args)  the local seat's selection (args.ids), e.g. a click on a unit tile in the HUD
--   on_action("skill_up", a)   raise ability slot a.slot of the local seat's hero
--   on_action("bind", args)    a runtime key bind: args.key with args.action, or args.remove = true
--   on_action("camera_to", a)  glide the camera to the ground point (a.x, a.z), e.g. a click on the minimap
--   on_action("viewport", a)   the ground rectangle the page shows: a.x0, a.z0, a.x1, a.z1 in tiles (double-click)
--   on_action("view", args)    the view toggles: args.fog (true or false); the page applies the reply
--   on_pointer(kind, x, y, button, state)  the local seat's ground event; kind "down", "up" or "move"; x, y in tiles
-- Every seat has its own selection, control groups, target arm and press. Feedback is sent out as UI events that
-- name their seat: game.ui_event("feedback", json) for markers, attack rings, the target arm, refusals and the
-- selection; game.ui_event("action", json) for panel actions (shop, scoreboard, custom); game.ui_event("view", json)
-- for the numbers the page applies. Commands are the engine's primitives: cmd_order, cmd_attack, cmd_cast,
-- cmd_use_item, cmd_hold, cmd_skill_up, attack_move, camera. The sandbox has no string or table library, so the
-- JSON below is built by hand.

local config = require("config")
local units = require("units")
local heroes = require("heroes")
local bots = require("bots")

local FIX = config.FIX
local TARGET_UNIT = 1
local TARGET_POINT = 2
local TICKS_PER_SECOND = config.TICKS_PER_SECOND

-- Defaults the page's ui data overrides in setup.
local CFG = {
  keys = {},
  custom = {},
  refusals = {},
  doubleTapTicks = 5,
  dragSlop = 0.25,
  pickRadius = 1.2,
  formationSpacing = 0.7,
  -- A move order is done once its unit is this close to the destination (world units).
  arriveRadius = 0.5,
  centreSeconds = 0.4,
}
local LOCAL = 0
local FOG_ON = true

-- Per-seat state: the selection, control groups, the target arm, the attack-move order, the press and the modifiers.
local STATE = {}
local function st(who)
  local s = STATE[who]
  if s == nil then
    s = { sel = {}, groups = {}, recalled = {}, armed = nil, attack_next = false, press = nil, held = {} }
    STATE[who] = s
  end
  return s
end

local function tile(v) return v / FIX end
local function fx(v) return math.floor(v * FIX) end
local function lo(a, b) if a < b then return a end return b end
local function hi(a, b) if a > b then return a end return b end

local function json_ids(list)
  local out = "["
  for i, id in ipairs(list) do
    if i > 1 then out = out .. "," end
    out = out .. tostring(id)
  end
  return out .. "]"
end

local function json_str(s) return '"' .. s .. '"' end

-- Feedback names its seat; the page shows it to that player.
local function feedback(who, body)
  game.ui_event("feedback", '{"player":' .. tostring(who) .. "," .. body .. "}")
end

-- The living own units of the selection, in selection order.
local function my_selected(who)
  local out = {}
  for _, id in ipairs(st(who).sel) do
    if units.own(id, who) then out[#out + 1] = id end
  end
  return out
end

local function hero_selected(who)
  return units.hero_of(st(who).sel, who)
end

local function set_selection(who, ids)
  local list = {}
  for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
    local dup = false
    for _, kept in ipairs(list) do
      if kept == id then dup = true end
    end
    if not dup and unit_alive(id) then list[#list + 1] = id end
  end
  st(who).sel = list
  feedback(who, '"kind":"selection","ids":' .. json_ids(list))
end

-- The unit nearest the ground point (x, z) within the pick radius, as {id, player}; nil for empty ground.
local function pick(x, z)
  local best, best_d = nil, nil
  for _, id in ipairs(game.units_near(fx(x), fx(z), fx(CFG.pickRadius))) do
    if unit_alive(id) then
      local ux, uz = unit_position(id)
      local dx, dz = tile(ux) - x, tile(uz) - z
      local d = dx * dx + dz * dz
      if best_d == nil or d < best_d then
        best, best_d = id, d
      end
    end
  end
  if best == nil then return nil end
  return { id = best, player = unit_player(best) }
end

local function is_enemy(who, hit) return hit ~= nil and hit.player ~= who end

-- A seat's own units in a ground box; a box holding any own hero keeps only the heroes.
local function box_ids(who, x0, z0, x1, z1, additive)
  local inside, heroes = {}, {}
  for _, id in ipairs(game.units(who)) do
    local ux, uz = unit_position(id)
    ux, uz = tile(ux), tile(uz)
    if ux >= lo(x0, x1) and ux <= hi(x0, x1) and uz >= lo(z0, z1) and uz <= hi(z0, z1) then
      inside[#inside + 1] = id
      if game.is_attributed(id) then heroes[#heroes + 1] = id end
    end
  end
  local picked = #heroes > 0 and heroes or inside
  if not additive then return picked end
  local out = {}
  for _, id in ipairs(st(who).sel) do out[#out + 1] = id end
  for _, id in ipairs(picked) do out[#out + 1] = id end
  return out
end

-- One unit clicked: it becomes the selection (enemies too, to read their stats); shift toggles it; empty ground clears.
local function click_ids(who, hit, additive)
  if hit == nil then
    if additive then return st(who).sel end
    return {}
  end
  if not additive then return { hit.id } end
  local out, found = {}, false
  for _, id in ipairs(st(who).sel) do
    if id == hit.id then found = true else out[#out + 1] = id end
  end
  if not found then out[#out + 1] = hit.id end
  return out
end

-- Double-click: the same own unit clicked twice within the double-tap window. The first click has already selected
-- it, so the second click is the one that selects its whole kind.
local function is_double_click(who, hit)
  local s = st(who)
  local now = game.time()
  local last = s.lastClick
  if hit == nil then
    s.lastClick = nil
    return false
  end
  s.lastClick = { id = hit.id, tick = now }
  return hit.player == who and last ~= nil and last.id == hit.id and now - last.tick <= CFG.doubleTapTicks
end

-- The page sends the ground rectangle it shows (action "viewport", tiles). Until it has sent one, nothing is off screen.
local function on_screen(who, id)
  local v = st(who).view
  if v == nil then return true end
  local ux, uz = unit_position(id)
  ux, uz = tile(ux), tile(uz)
  return ux >= v.x0 and ux <= v.x1 and uz >= v.z0 and uz <= v.z1
end

-- The living units of seat `who` that have the kind of unit `id` and are on screen, in unit order.
local function same_kind_on_screen(who, id)
  local kind = game.unit_kind(id)
  if kind == nil then return { id } end
  local out = {}
  for _, u in ipairs(game.units(who)) do
    if game.unit_kind(u) == kind and on_screen(who, u) then out[#out + 1] = u end
  end
  return out
end


local function refuse(who, reason)
  local text = CFG.refusals[reason] or CFG.refusals.refused or reason
  feedback(who, '"kind":"refusal","reason":' .. json_str(reason) .. ',"text":' .. json_str(text))
end

local function arm(who, state)
  st(who).armed = state
  local item = state.item and "true" or "false"
  feedback(who, '"kind":"targetArm","slot":' .. tostring(state.slot) .. ',"item":' .. item ..
    ',"radius":' .. tostring(state.radius) .. ',"targetKind":' .. json_str(state.kind))
end

local function disarm(who)
  local s = st(who)
  if s.armed == nil then return false end
  s.armed = nil
  feedback(who, '"kind":"targetEnd"')
  return true
end

-- A ground order: a move, or an attack-move when attack is set. Clicking an enemy attacks it either way. Units keep
-- formation spots around the point, so they do not stack.
-- Orders waiting behind a unit's current one (shift-queued), by unit id. The head is issued when the unit goes idle
-- (game.order_of reports ORDER_STOP), so a queue is a mod rule: the sim keeps one order per unit and its state
-- hash is unchanged. Issued in ascending id order, so every peer applies the same commands.
local QUEUE = {}
local ORDER_STOP = 1

local function issue(id, o)
  if o.enemy ~= nil then
    game.cmd_attack(id, o.enemy)
  elseif o.attack then
    game.attack_move(id, fx(o.x), fx(o.z))
  else
    game.cmd_order(id, fx(o.x), fx(o.z))
  end
end

local function order_selected(who, x, z, enemy, attack, queued)
  local ids = my_selected(who)
  if #ids == 0 then return false end
  if enemy ~= nil then
    feedback(who, '"kind":"attack","x":' .. tostring(x) .. ',"z":' .. tostring(z) .. ',"targetId":' .. tostring(enemy.id))
  else
    local kind = attack and "attackMove" or "move"
    feedback(who, '"kind":' .. json_str(kind) .. ',"x":' .. tostring(x) .. ',"z":' .. tostring(z) .. ',"ids":' .. json_ids(ids))
  end
  local spacing = CFG.formationSpacing
  for i, id in ipairs(ids) do
    local o = { x = x, z = z, attack = attack, enemy = enemy and enemy.id or nil }
    if enemy == nil then
      o.x = x + ((i - 1) % 3 - 1) * spacing
      o.z = z + math.floor((i - 1) / 3) * spacing
    end
    if queued then
      local q = QUEUE[id] or {}
      q[#q + 1] = o
      QUEUE[id] = q
    else
      QUEUE[id] = nil
      issue(id, o)
    end
  end
  return true
end

-- Stop and hold replace the order, so they also drop the shift-queued orders behind it.
local function stop_selected(who)
  for _, id in ipairs(my_selected(who)) do
    QUEUE[id] = nil
    local ux, uz = unit_position(id)
    game.cmd_order(id, ux, uz)
  end
end

local function hold_selected(who)
  for _, id in ipairs(my_selected(who)) do
    QUEUE[id] = nil
    game.cmd_hold(id)
  end
end

local function centre_on(who, id)
  local ux, uz = unit_position(id)
  game.camera(who, ux, uz, 1, CFG.centreSeconds)
end

-- Space: the camera glides to the hero, or to the first selected unit when no hero is selected.
local function centre_selected(who)
  local id = hero_selected(who)
  if id == nil then id = my_selected(who)[1] end
  if id ~= nil then centre_on(who, id) end
end

local function ability_of(hero, slot)
  for _, a in ipairs(game.unit_abilities(hero)) do
    if a.slot == slot then return a end
  end
  return nil
end

local function cast_now(hero, slot, target, x, z)
  game.cmd_cast(hero, slot, target, fx(x), fx(z))
end

-- A cast the sim would refuse for range, refused here instead so the page can say why: cmd_cast only
-- queues the command and never answers, so a refusal the sim makes reaches nobody. cast_range is milli
-- (one reference unit is 15.625 milli) and positions are Q16.16. An ability that declares no range is
-- never refused here -- the sim decides those.
local function out_of_range(hero, name, x, z, target)
  local ext = ability_ext(name)
  local reach = ext and ext.cast_range or 0
  if reach <= 0 then return false end
  local hx, hz = unit_position(hero)
  local tx, tz = fx(x), fx(z)
  if target ~= nil and target >= 0 then tx, tz = unit_position(target) end
  local dx, dz = tx - hx, tz - hz
  local limit = config.milli(reach)
  return dx * dx + dz * dz > limit * limit
end

-- A cast key: a point or unit ability arms until the next left click; any other casts at once at the pointer.
local function cast_key(who, slot, wx, wz)
  local hero = hero_selected(who)
  if hero == nil then return refuse(who, "noHero") end
  local a = ability_of(hero, slot)
  if a == nil then return refuse(who, "noAbility") end
  if game.unit_cooldown(hero, slot) > 0 then return refuse(who, "cooldown") end
  local info = ability_info(a.name)
  if info.target == TARGET_UNIT then
    return arm(who, { item = false, slot = slot, kind = "unit", radius = 0 })
  end
  if info.target == TARGET_POINT then
    return arm(who, { item = false, slot = slot, kind = "point", radius = 0 })
  end
  if wx == nil then
    local ux, uz = unit_position(hero)
    cast_now(hero, slot, -1, ux, uz)
    return
  end
  local hit = pick(wx, wz)
  if out_of_range(hero, a.name, wx, wz, hit and hit.id or -1) then return refuse(who, "range") end
  cast_now(hero, slot, hit and hit.id or -1, wx, wz)
end

-- An item key: items cast at once on the hero (their target data is not exported yet).
local function item_key(who, slot)
  local hero = hero_selected(who)
  if hero == nil then return refuse(who, "noHero") end
  for _, it in ipairs(game.unit_items(hero)) do
    if it.slot == slot then
      local ux, uz = unit_position(hero)
      game.cmd_use_item(hero, slot, -1, ux, uz)
      return
    end
  end
  refuse(who, "noItem")
end

-- The left click that completes an armed cast; a unit-targeted spell waits while the click finds no unit.
local function resolve_armed(who, x, z)
  local s = st(who)
  local hero = hero_selected(who)
  if hero == nil then
    disarm(who)
    return refuse(who, "noHero")
  end
  local hit = pick(x, z)
  if s.armed.kind == "unit" and hit == nil then return refuse(who, "noTarget") end
  local a = s.armed
  disarm(who)
  if a.item then
    game.cmd_use_item(hero, a.slot, hit and hit.id or -1, fx(x), fx(z))
    return
  end
  if ability_of(hero, a.slot) == nil then return refuse(who, "noAbility") end
  local named = ability_of(hero, a.slot)
  if out_of_range(hero, named.name, x, z, hit and hit.id or -1) then return refuse(who, "range") end
  cast_now(hero, a.slot, hit and hit.id or -1, x, z)
end

local function skill_up(who, slot)
  local hero = hero_selected(who)
  if hero == nil then return refuse(who, "noHero") end
  game.cmd_skill_up(hero, slot)
end

local function recall(who, slot)
  local s = st(who)
  local now = game.time()
  local ids = s.groups[slot] or {}
  local previous = s.recalled[slot]
  s.recalled[slot] = now
  local alive = {}
  for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
    if units.own(id, who) then alive[#alive + 1] = id end
  end
  set_selection(who, alive)
  if previous ~= nil and now - previous <= CFG.doubleTapTicks and alive[1] ~= nil then
    centre_on(who, alive[1])
  end
end

local function index_of(list, key)
  for i, k in ipairs(list or {}) do
    if k == key then return i - 1 end
  end
  return nil
end

local function contains(list, key) return index_of(list, key) ~= nil end

-- The action a key means, and its argument (a slot, or a custom action name). Runtime binds win over the defaults.
local function resolve_key(key, mods)
  local custom = CFG.custom[key]
  if custom ~= nil then return "custom", custom end
  local keys = CFG.keys
  local group = keys.group or {}
  local slot = index_of(group.keys, key)
  if slot ~= nil then
    if mods[group.modifier] then return "setGroup", slot end
    return "recallGroup", slot
  end
  if contains(keys.attackMove, key) then return "attackMove" end
  if contains(keys.stop, key) then return "stop" end
  if contains(keys.hold, key) then return "hold" end
  if contains(keys.centre, key) then return "centre" end
  if contains(keys.scoreboard, key) then return "scoreboard" end
  if contains(keys.shop, key) then return "shop" end
  local item = index_of(keys.item, key)
  if item ~= nil then return "item", item end
  local skill = keys.skillUp or {}
  if skill.keys ~= nil and skill.keys[key] ~= nil and mods[skill.modifier] then
    return "skillUp", skill.keys[key]
  end
  if keys.cast ~= nil and keys.cast[key] ~= nil then return "cast", keys.cast[key] end
  return nil
end

local function on_key(who, a)
  local s = st(who)
  s.held.shift, s.held.ctrl, s.held.alt = a.shift, a.ctrl or a.meta, a.alt
  if a.phase == "up" then return end
  if s.armed ~= nil and a.key == "escape" then
    disarm(who)
    return
  end
  local action, arg = resolve_key(a.key, { ctrl = s.held.ctrl, shift = s.held.shift, alt = s.held.alt })
  if action == nil then return end
  local wx, wz = nil, nil
  if a.world ~= nil then wx, wz = a.world.x, a.world.z end
  if s.armed ~= nil and (action == "cast" or action == "item") and arg == s.armed.slot and (action == "item") == s.armed.item then
    disarm(who)
    return
  end
  if action == "attackMove" then
    s.attack_next = true
  elseif action == "stop" then
    stop_selected(who)
  elseif action == "hold" then
    hold_selected(who)
  elseif action == "centre" then
    centre_selected(who)
  elseif action == "cast" then
    cast_key(who, arg, wx, wz)
  elseif action == "item" then
    item_key(who, arg)
  elseif action == "skillUp" then
    skill_up(who, arg)
  elseif action == "setGroup" then
    s.groups[arg] = my_selected(who)
  elseif action == "recallGroup" then
    recall(who, arg)
  elseif action == "custom" then
    game.ui_event("action", '{"player":' .. tostring(who) .. ',"action":"custom","name":' .. json_str(arg) .. "}")
  else
    game.ui_event("action", '{"player":' .. tostring(who) .. ',"action":' .. json_str(action) .. "}")
  end
end

local function dist2(ax, az, bx, bz)
  local dx, dz = ax - bx, az - bz
  return dx * dx + dz * dz
end

-- A ground press and its release. A drag that moved is a box select (left) or nothing (right: the camera orbits).
local function on_ground(who, kind, x, y, button)
  local s = st(who)
  if kind == "down" then
    s.press = { x = x, z = y, button = button, shift = s.held.shift }
    return
  end
  if kind ~= "up" or s.press == nil then return end
  local p = s.press
  s.press = nil
  local moved = dist2(p.x, p.z, x, y) > CFG.dragSlop * CFG.dragSlop
  if p.button == 2 then
    if moved then return end
    if s.armed ~= nil then
      disarm(who)
      return
    end
    s.attack_next = false
    local hit = pick(x, y)
    order_selected(who, x, y, is_enemy(who, hit) and hit or nil, false, p.shift)
    return
  end
  if p.button ~= 0 then return end
  if moved then
    set_selection(who, box_ids(who, p.x, p.z, x, y, p.shift))
    return
  end
  if s.armed ~= nil then
    resolve_armed(who, x, y)
    return
  end
  local hit = pick(x, y)
  local double = is_double_click(who, hit)
  if s.attack_next then
    s.attack_next = false
    order_selected(who, x, y, is_enemy(who, hit) and hit or nil, true, p.shift)
    return
  end
  if double and not p.shift then
    set_selection(who, same_kind_on_screen(who, hit.id))
    return
  end
  set_selection(who, click_ids(who, hit, p.shift))
end

local function setup(args)
  local ui = args.ui or {}
  CFG.keys = ui.keys or CFG.keys
  CFG.refusals = (ui.text or {}).refusals or CFG.refusals
  CFG.doubleTapTicks = math.floor((ui.doubleTapMs or 350) * TICKS_PER_SECOND / 1000)
  CFG.dragSlop = ui.dragSlopTiles or CFG.dragSlop
  CFG.pickRadius = ui.pickRadius or CFG.pickRadius
  CFG.formationSpacing = ui.formationSpacing or CFG.formationSpacing
  CFG.centreSeconds = ui.centreSeconds or CFG.centreSeconds
  LOCAL = args.player or LOCAL
end

-- The actions this file answers, listed for the page's debug API (oscraft.debug.actions()).
local ACTIONS = { "setup", "key", "pointer", "select", "ui", "skill_up", "seat_pick", "bind", "camera_to", "view", "viewport", "debug_actions" }

local function on_action(name, args)
  if name == "debug_actions" then
    local out = "["
    for i, action in ipairs(ACTIONS) do
      if i > 1 then out = out .. "," end
      out = out .. json_str(action)
    end
    game.ui_event("debug", '{"actions":' .. out .. "]}")
  elseif name == "setup" then
    setup(args)
  elseif name == "key" then
    on_key(args.player or LOCAL, args)
  elseif name == "pointer" then
    on_ground(args.player or LOCAL, args.kind, args.x, args.y, args.button)
  elseif name == "select" then
    set_selection(args.player or LOCAL, args.ids or {})
  elseif name == "ui" then
    -- A panel's button press (panels.lua owns the panels): the selection tiles select through here.
    if args.call == "select" and args.args ~= nil then set_selection(args.player or LOCAL, args.args.ids or {}) end
    if args.call == "cast" and args.args ~= nil and args.args.slot ~= nil then cast_key(args.player or LOCAL, args.args.slot) end
  elseif name == "viewport" then
    if args.x0 and args.z0 and args.x1 and args.z1 then
      st(args.player or LOCAL).view = { x0 = args.x0, z0 = args.z0, x1 = args.x1, z1 = args.z1 }
    end
  elseif name == "skill_up" then
    skill_up(args.player or LOCAL, args.slot)
  elseif name == "seat_pick" then
    heroes.seat_pick(args.player, args.hero)
    if args.bot then bots.seat(args.player) end
  elseif name == "bind" then
    if args.remove then CFG.custom[args.key] = nil else CFG.custom[args.key] = args.action end
  elseif name == "camera_to" then
    game.camera(args.player or LOCAL, fx(args.x), fx(args.z), 1, CFG.centreSeconds)
  elseif name == "view" then
    FOG_ON = args.fog ~= false
    game.ui_event("view", '{"player":' .. tostring(LOCAL) .. ',"fog":' .. (FOG_ON and "true" or "false") ..
      ',"centreSeconds":' .. tostring(CFG.centreSeconds) .. "}")
  end
end

local function on_pointer(kind, x, y, button)
  if kind == "move" then return end
  on_ground(LOCAL, kind, x, y, button)
end

-- A unit is idle when it stands on a stop order, or on a move that has reached its destination. A move keeps its
-- kind on arrival, so the arrival test is the only signal the sim gives for it.
local function idle(id)
  local kind, tx, ty = game.order_of(id)
  if kind == ORDER_STOP then return true end
  return game.within(id, tx, ty, fx(CFG.arriveRadius))
end

-- Issues the next queued order of each idle unit, in ascending id order (the order game.units lists them, so every
-- peer applies the same commands). Only a unit with a queue can take one, so the tick walks those ids instead of
-- building the whole unit list every tick: a queue is empty on most ticks, and then the sim is asked for nothing.
local function on_tick()
  if next(QUEUE) == nil then return end
  local ids = {}
  -- The sandbox has no table library, so the ids are kept in ascending order by insertion.
  for id in pairs(QUEUE) do
    local j = #ids + 1
    while j > 1 and ids[j - 1] > id do
      ids[j] = ids[j - 1]
      j = j - 1
    end
    ids[j] = id
  end
  for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
    local q = QUEUE[id]
    if q ~= nil and not game.alive(id) then
      QUEUE[id] = nil
    elseif q ~= nil then
      if #q == 0 then
        QUEUE[id] = nil
      elseif idle(id) then
        local o = q[1]
        for k = 1, #q - 1 do q[k] = q[k + 1] end
        q[#q] = nil
        issue(id, o)
      end
    end
  end
end

return { on_action = on_action, on_pointer = on_pointer, on_tick = on_tick }

-- Computer-controlled heroes: each bot seat's hero is driven by the bot library (bot_lib.lua), once every Bot.DECIDE_EVERY
-- ticks. A seat becomes a bot when its pick says so: controls.lua routes the "seat_pick" action, with args.bot, here.
local Bot = require("bot_lib")

local bots = {}
local bot_of = {}

local function seat(player)
  if bot_of[player] ~= nil then return end
  local bot = Bot.new(player, player)
  bot_of[player] = bot
  bots[#bots + 1] = bot
end

return {
  seat = seat,

  on_tick = function(state)
    local ticks = game.time()
    local units = nil
    for index, bot in ipairs(bots) do
      if (ticks + index) % Bot.DECIDE_EVERY == 0 then
        units = units or game.units(nil)
        Bot.think(bot, units, ticks)
      end
    end
    state.bot_walks = Bot.stats.walks
    state.bot_attacks = Bot.stats.attacks
    state.bot_retreats = Bot.stats.retreats
    state.bot_seats = #bots
  end,
}

name: bot_lib.lua
text:
-- Bot library: the decision logic of a computer-controlled hero, written only against the mod API.
-- A module of the moba pack: bots.lua requires it and drives each bot seat's hero. Returns Bot.
-- Uses game.units, game.is_attributed, game.unit_abilities, game.unit_cooldown, game.xp, game.xp_curve, game.unit_items,
-- game.gold, game.team, game.time, game.cmd_order, game.cmd_attack, game.cmd_cast, game.cmd_use_item,
-- game.cmd_buy, unit_position, unit_hp and unit_alive.

local TILE = 65536
local NEUTRAL = 255
local TICKS_PER_SECOND = 16

Bot = { stats = { walks = 0, retreats = 0, attacks = 0, blinks = 0, helps = 0, heals = 0 }, roster = {} }

-- One decision every 2 ticks: 0.125 s, the whole-tick count nearest the 0.1 s loop (1.6 ticks at 16 a second).
Bot.DECIDE_EVERY = 2
local CAST_EVERY = 16
local CAST_REACH = 7
local LAST_HIT_HP = 60
local SHOP_REACH = 1.5

-- Ranges are written in the script's units. A map cell is 64 of them, as the blink check in
-- rust/gate/src/ability_checks.rs implies (875 * 15.625 / 1000 cells).
local function cells(units) return units * 15.625 / 1000 end
local ENGAGE_HERO = cells(800)
local ENGAGE_CREEP = cells(1100)
local ENGAGE_CROWD = cells(750)
local CROWD_MAX = 2
local ENGAGE_MIN_LEVEL = 3
local ENGAGE_MIN_PCT = 70
local RETARGET_RANGE = cells(600)
local SEARCH_RANGE = cells(700)
local HELP_RANGE = cells(1100)
local ATTACK_GROUP_RANGE = cells(1200)
local BLINK_TRIGGER = cells(2000)
local BLINK_SHORT = cells(500)
local FAR_HIGH = cells(1500)
local FAR_LOW = cells(750)
local DISENGAGE_LEVEL = 6
local DISENGAGE_GAP = 20
local HERO_SEARCH_PCT = 50
local ENEMY_LEVEL_HP = 20
local RETREAT_PCT = 40
local RETREAT_HP = 300
local RETREAT_HP_PER_LEVEL = 30
local RECOVER_FRACTION = 0.8
local HEAL_PCT = 50
local HEAL_ITEM = "flask"
local BLINK_ITEM = "blink"

local LANE_OF_SEAT = { "top", "mid", "bot", "mid", "top" }
-- A lane's route id in routes.osd (route(player, id, ...)): top 1, mid 2, bot 3.
local LANE_ROUTE = { top = 1, mid = 2, bot = 3 }
-- Catalog index and gold cost of each purchase, in the order a bot buys them.
local SHOPPING = { { 2, 200 }, { 6, 350 }, { 0, 150 }, { 1, 150 }, { 7, 300 }, { 10, 600 } }

local function fixed(v) return (v // 1) | 0 end

local function distance_tiles(ax, ay, bx, by)
  local dx, dy = (ax - bx) / TILE, (ay - by) / TILE
  return (dx * dx + dy * dy) ^ 0.5
end

local function whole_hp(unit) return unit_hp(unit) / TILE end

-- The level of a unit: the count of the xp curve's thresholds its xp has reached. This file is one chunk with its
-- seat file and cannot require shared/xp.lua, so it carries its own copy of the rule.
local function unit_level(unit)
  local have = game.xp(unit)
  local level = 0
  for _, threshold in ipairs(game.xp_curve()) do
    if threshold <= have then level = level + 1 end
  end
  return level
end

-- Health percent against the most HP this unit has shown; the mod API exposes no max HP.
local seen_max_hp = {}
local function hp_pct(unit)
  local hp = unit_hp(unit)
  if (seen_max_hp[unit] or 0) < hp then seen_max_hp[unit] = hp end
  return hp * 100 / seen_max_hp[unit]
end

local function hostile(team_a, unit)
  local player = unit_player(unit)
  if player == NEUTRAL then return true end
  local ok, team = pcall(game.team, player)
  return ok and team ~= team_a
end

local function dist_from(hero, unit)
  local hx, hy = unit_position(hero)
  local x, y = unit_position(unit)
  return distance_tiles(hx, hy, x, y)
end

-- Living units that are hostile to the team, other than the hero itself.
local function hostile_list(team, units, hero)
  local list = {}
  for _, unit in ipairs(units) do
    if unit ~= hero and unit_alive(unit) and hostile(team, unit) then list[#list + 1] = unit end
  end
  return list
end

-- The first ready item of this name in the hero's inventory, or nil.
local function ready_item(hero, name)
  for _, item in ipairs(game.unit_items(hero)) do
    if item.name == name and item.count > 0 and item.cooldown == 0 then return item end
  end
  return nil
end

function Bot.new(slot, seat)
  local bot = {
    slot = slot,
    lane = LANE_OF_SEAT[seat % #LANE_OF_SEAT + 1],
    shopped = 0,
    last_cast = -CAST_EVERY,
    hero = nil,
    target = nil,
    retreating = false,
  }
  Bot.roster[#Bot.roster + 1] = bot
  return bot
end

function Bot.find_hero(bot)
  for _, unit in ipairs(game.units(bot.slot)) do
    if game.is_attributed(unit) then return unit end
  end
  return nil
end

-- Engage search (87122-87125): the nearest enemy hero within 800, else a creep within 1100. A creep at
-- or under LAST_HIT_HP within that reach is taken ahead of the nearest one, so a last hit still comes first.
-- Hero engagements pass the gate below; creep last hits do not, so a level-1 hero still last-hits.
local function search_target(hero, enemies, hero_ok)
  local hero_pick, hero_d = nil, ENGAGE_HERO
  local weak_pick, weak_d = nil, ENGAGE_CREEP
  local creep_pick, creep_d = nil, ENGAGE_CREEP
  for _, unit in ipairs(enemies) do
    local d = dist_from(hero, unit)
    if game.is_attributed(unit) then
      if hero_ok and d < hero_d then hero_pick, hero_d = unit, d end
    elseif d < ENGAGE_CREEP then
      local hp = whole_hp(unit)
      if hp > 0 and hp <= LAST_HIT_HP and d < weak_d then weak_pick, weak_d = unit, d end
      if d < creep_d then creep_pick, creep_d = unit, d end
    end
  end
  if hero_pick then return hero_pick end
  return weak_pick or creep_pick
end

-- Engage gate for enemy heroes (87121, 87131): above level 3, HP above 70%, at most 2 enemies within 750.
-- The AI flag is set on every bot slot, so it is not checked. The unnamed test on 87131 (Q77) is not read.
local function may_engage(hero, enemies)
  if unit_level(hero) <= ENGAGE_MIN_LEVEL then return false end
  if hp_pct(hero) <= ENGAGE_MIN_PCT then return false end
  local near = 0
  for _, unit in ipairs(enemies) do
    if dist_from(hero, unit) <= ENGAGE_CROWD then near = near + 1 end
  end
  return near <= CROWD_MAX
end

-- Retarget (87137-87150). A hero target above 50% HP opens a search within 700; otherwise candidates
-- within 600 count. A candidate takes over when it has less HP than the target, or, while the target is
-- above 50%, when its HP plus 20 x its level is still below the target's HP. The lowest such candidate wins.
local function retarget(hero, target, enemies)
  local tpct = hp_pct(target)
  local search = game.is_attributed(target) and tpct > HERO_SEARCH_PCT
  local range = search and SEARCH_RANGE or RETARGET_RANGE
  local target_hp = whole_hp(target)
  local best, best_hp = target, target_hp
  for _, unit in ipairs(enemies) do
    if unit ~= target and dist_from(hero, unit) < range then
      local hp = whole_hp(unit)
      local wins
      if tpct > HERO_SEARCH_PCT then
        wins = hp + ENEMY_LEVEL_HP * unit_level(unit) < target_hp
      else
        wins = hp < target_hp
      end
      if wins and hp < best_hp then best, best_hp = unit, hp end
    end
  end
  return best
end

-- Disengage (87154-87160), for a hero target. At level 6 and above: out of 1500 range, or own HP% + 20 below
-- the target's HP%. Below level 6: out of 750 range, or own HP% - 20 below the target's HP%.
local function disengage(hero, target)
  if not game.is_attributed(target) then return false end
  local far, gap
  if unit_level(hero) >= DISENGAGE_LEVEL then
    far, gap = FAR_HIGH, DISENGAGE_GAP
  else
    far, gap = FAR_LOW, -DISENGAGE_GAP
  end
  return dist_from(hero, target) > far or hp_pct(hero) + gap < hp_pct(target)
end

-- Attack group (66155-66172): when a bot takes a target, the other bots whose heroes are within 1200 of it
-- are ordered onto the same target. The 2400 range for flagged units is not applied (no flag in the API).
function Bot.alert(bot, team, target)
  for _, other in ipairs(Bot.roster) do
    if other ~= bot and other.hero and unit_alive(other.hero) and game.team(other.slot) == team then
      if dist_from(other.hero, target) <= ATTACK_GROUP_RANGE then other.target = target end
    end
  end
end

-- Help (66195-66222): the living ally hero within 1100 with the lowest HP is the one to help. The enemy it
-- is facing is the nearest enemy within 800 of that ally. Without one, the fallback is the nearest enemy
-- within 800 of this hero, which the engage search already covers, so nil is returned.
local function help_target(hero, units, team, enemies)
  local ally, ally_hp = nil, nil
  for _, unit in ipairs(units) do
    if unit ~= hero and game.is_attributed(unit) and unit_alive(unit) and not hostile(team, unit)
      and dist_from(hero, unit) <= HELP_RANGE then
      local hp = whole_hp(unit)
      if ally_hp == nil or hp < ally_hp then ally, ally_hp = unit, hp end
    end
  end
  if not ally then return nil end
  local pick, pick_d = nil, ENGAGE_HERO
  for _, unit in ipairs(enemies) do
    local d = dist_from(ally, unit)
    if d < pick_d then pick, pick_d = unit, d end
  end
  if pick then Bot.stats.helps = Bot.stats.helps + 1 end
  return pick
end

-- Blink to a point 500 short of the target on the caster-to-target line (point 6583-6585, order 6592-6593).
function Bot.blink_to(hero, target)
  local item = ready_item(hero, BLINK_ITEM)
  if not item then return false end
  local hx, hy = unit_position(hero)
  local tx, ty = unit_position(target)
  local dx, dy = tx - hx, ty - hy
  local len = (dx * dx + dy * dy) ^ 0.5
  if len == 0 then return false end
  local px = tx - dx / len * BLINK_SHORT * TILE
  local py = ty - dy / len * BLINK_SHORT * TILE
  game.cmd_use_item(hero, item.slot, -1, fixed(px), fixed(py))
  Bot.stats.blinks = Bot.stats.blinks + 1
  return true
end

-- Heal consumable (90338): below 50% HP the flask is drunk on the hero. Every bot slot carries the AI flag,
-- so the "target or flag" test always passes.
function Bot.heal(hero)
  if hp_pct(hero) >= HEAL_PCT then return false end
  local item = ready_item(hero, HEAL_ITEM)
  if not item then return false end
  game.cmd_use_item(hero, item.slot, hero, 0, 0)
  Bot.stats.heals = Bot.stats.heals + 1
  return true
end

function Bot.learn_skills(hero)
  if not game.cmd_skill_up then return end
  for _, ability in ipairs(game.unit_abilities(hero)) do game.cmd_skill_up(hero, ability.slot) end
end

function Bot.cast_ready(bot, hero, target, ticks)
  if ticks - bot.last_cast < CAST_EVERY then return end
  bot.last_cast = ticks
  for _, ability in ipairs(game.unit_abilities(hero)) do
    if game.unit_cooldown(hero, ability.slot) == 0 then
      game.cmd_cast(hero, ability.slot, target, 0, 0)
      return
    end
  end
end

-- The position (fixed point) of the base of a player, from the live unit; nil when the player has none.
local function base_of(player)
  for _, unit in ipairs(game.units(player)) do
    if game.unit_kind(unit) == "base" then return unit_position(unit) end
  end
  return nil
end

-- The position of an enemy base: the first base of a player hostile to `player`; nil when none is standing.
local function enemy_base(player)
  for q = 0, 15 do
    if q ~= player and game.hostile(player, q) then
      local x, y = base_of(q)
      if x ~= nil then return x, y end
    end
  end
  return nil
end

function Bot.shop(bot, hero, team, player)
  local item = SHOPPING[bot.shopped + 1]
  if not item or game.gold(player) < item[2] then return false end
  local hx, hy = unit_position(hero)
  local sx, sy = base_of(player)
  if sx ~= nil and distance_tiles(hx, hy, sx, sy) > SHOP_REACH then
    game.cmd_order(hero, sx, sy)
    return true
  end
  game.cmd_buy(hero, item[1])
  bot.shopped = bot.shopped + 1
  return true
end

function Bot.retreat(bot, hero, team)
  local fx, fy = base_of(bot.slot)
  if fx == nil then return end
  Bot.stats.retreats = Bot.stats.retreats + 1
  game.cmd_order(hero, fx, fy)
end

-- Walks the bot's lane: the map's route for its side and lane (routes.osd), from the route point nearest the hero to the
-- next one. Past the route's last point, or with no route, it heads for the enemy base.
function Bot.walk_lane(bot, hero, team)
  local route = LANE_ROUTE[bot.lane]
  local n = route and route_len(team, route) or 0
  if n > 0 then
    local hx, hy = unit_position(hero)
    local near, near_d = 0, math.huge
    for step = 0, n - 1 do
      local px, py = route_point(team, route, step)
      local d = distance_tiles(hx, hy, px, py)
      if d < near_d then near, near_d = step, d end
    end
    if near + 1 < n then
      local wx, wy = route_point(team, route, near + 1)
      Bot.stats.walks = Bot.stats.walks + 1
      game.cmd_order(hero, wx, wy)
      return
    end
  end
  local x, y = enemy_base(bot.slot)
  if x == nil then return end
  Bot.stats.walks = Bot.stats.walks + 1
  game.cmd_order(hero, x, y)
end

-- One decision for a bot: returns the hero it controls, or nil when the slot has none alive.
function Bot.think(bot, units, ticks)
  local hero = Bot.find_hero(bot)
  bot.hero = hero
  if not hero then
    bot.retreating = false
    bot.target = nil
    return nil
  end
  local team = game.team(bot.slot)
  Bot.learn_skills(hero)
  Bot.heal(hero)

  -- Retreat below 40% HP and below 300 + 30 x level (87101, 5425-5427); recover at 80%.
  local pct = hp_pct(hero)
  local hp = whole_hp(hero)
  if bot.retreating and pct >= RECOVER_FRACTION * 100 then bot.retreating = false end
  if not bot.retreating and pct < RETREAT_PCT and hp < RETREAT_HP + RETREAT_HP_PER_LEVEL * unit_level(hero) then
    bot.retreating = true
  end
  if bot.retreating then
    bot.target = nil
    Bot.retreat(bot, hero, team)
    return hero
  end
  if Bot.shop(bot, hero, team, bot.slot) then return hero end

  local enemies = hostile_list(team, units, hero)
  local target = bot.target
  if target and not (unit_alive(target) and hostile(team, target)) then target = nil end
  if target and disengage(hero, target) then
    bot.target = nil
    Bot.retreat(bot, hero, team)
    return hero
  end
  if target then target = retarget(hero, target, enemies) end
  if not target then
    local hero_ok = may_engage(hero, enemies)
    target = search_target(hero, enemies, hero_ok)
    if not target and hero_ok then target = help_target(hero, units, team, enemies) end
  end
  if not target then
    bot.target = nil
    Bot.walk_lane(bot, hero, team)
    return hero
  end

  if target ~= bot.target then Bot.alert(bot, team, target) end
  bot.target = target
  local d = dist_from(hero, target)
  if d >= BLINK_TRIGGER and Bot.blink_to(hero, target) then return hero end
  if d < CAST_REACH then Bot.cast_ready(bot, hero, target, ticks) end
  Bot.stats.attacks = Bot.stats.attacks + 1
  game.cmd_attack(hero, target)
  return hero
end

return Bot

name: panels.lua
text:
-- The moba panels, as mod code. Each panel is a widget tree (JSON, below) that the page draws with its generic widgets;
-- this file decides what every panel shows and what its buttons do. The page only draws the trees and sends a button
-- press back as the "ui" action. The panels refresh on a periodic timer (game.timer).
--   on_action(name, args)  "setup" (args.ui: the parsed moba_ui.json object, with text, keys and teams; args.player the local seat; args.pubkey
--                                 the lobby owner of this page), "key" (the shop and scoreboard keys toggle their panels),
--                                 "selection" (the local seat's selection, args.ids, sent by the page on every change),
--                                 "ui" (a button press: args.call names the call, args.args holds its values)
-- A panel goes out as game.ui_event("widget", {player, id, slot, tree}); a closed one as {player, id, remove}. The
-- lobby's start goes out as game.ui_event("lobby", {player, started, slots}) and the page starts the match from it.
-- A node is {"t": "panel"|"box"|"label"|"bar"|"button"|"grid"|"cell"|"image", ...}: panel (title, kids), box (dir "row" or "col",
-- kids), label (text, tone), bar (value, max, tone), button (text, call, args, disabled), grid (cols, kids), cell (kids,
-- tone, tip, call, args), image (src, size, alt). Tones are named by the page's stylesheet. The sandbox has no string library, so the JSON is
-- built by hand.

local config = require("config")
local units = require("units")
local xp = require("xp")

local TICKS_PER_SECOND = config.TICKS_PER_SECOND
local REFRESH_TICKS = 4
-- Six inventory slots, the DotA 1 count verified against the 6.88g map. There is no backpack: that is Dota 2
-- 7.00. Extras go to the stash or a courier, so anything beyond these six is not a carried slot.
local INVENTORY_SLOTS = 6
local STASH_SLOTS = 9
-- Inventory slot 9 is the neutral slot: a recipe component is never held there (store.lua, sim inventory.rs).
local NEUTRAL_SLOT = 9
local ABILITY_SLOTS = 8
local TEAM_SIZE = 5
-- Lobby seats (5 a side), not inventory: a slot here holds a player or a bot and its chosen hero.
local SLOT_COUNT = 10
local GROUP_TILES = 12
local TALENT_FIRST_BIT = 2
local TALENT_LEVELS = { 10, 15, 20, 25 }

local TEXT = {}
local UI = {}
local KEYS = {}
local LOCAL = 0
local OWNER = "local"
local SEL = {}
local OPEN = { shop = false, scoreboard = false, controls = false }
-- The inventory slot whose sell was pressed once: a second press on the same slot sells.
local SELL_ARMED = nil
local HORN = nil
local PEAK = {}
-- The longest cooldown seen per unit and slot: the sweep's full length for an ability with no rank table.
local COOLDOWN_FULL = {}
local HEROES = {}
local ROSTER = nil
local LAST = {}

local function new_lobby()
  local slots = {}
  for i = 1, SLOT_COUNT do slots[i] = { owner = nil, hero = nil, ready = false, bot = false } end
  return { host = nil, started = false, worldReady = false, slots = slots, error = "" }
end
local LOBBY = new_lobby()

-- JSON pieces. A field is '"k":v' with v already encoded.
local function join(items, sep)
  local out = ""
  for i, v in ipairs(items) do
    if i > 1 then out = out .. sep end
    out = out .. v
  end
  return out
end
local function S(k, v) return '"' .. k .. '":"' .. tostring(v) .. '"' end
local function I(k, v) return '"' .. k .. '":' .. tostring(v) end
local function B(k, v) return '"' .. k .. '":' .. (v and "true" or "false") end
local function R(k, v) return '"' .. k .. '":' .. v end
local function arr(items) return "[" .. join(items, ",") .. "]" end
local function obj(items) return "{" .. join(items, ",") .. "}" end
local function with(items, extra)
  if extra ~= nil then items[#items + 1] = extra end
  return items
end

local function node(t, fields)
  local f = { S("t", t) }
  for _, v in ipairs(fields) do f[#f + 1] = v end
  return obj(f)
end
local function box(kids, dir) return node("box", { S("dir", dir or "col"), R("kids", arr(kids)) }) end
local function label(text, tone)
  return node("label", with({ S("text", text) }, tone and S("tone", tone) or nil))
end
local function bar(value, max, tone)
  return node("bar", with({ I("value", value), I("max", max) }, tone and S("tone", tone) or nil))
end
local function button(text, call, args, disabled, tip)
  local f = { S("text", text), S("call", call), R("args", args or "{}") }
  if disabled then f[#f + 1] = B("disabled", true) end
  if tip then f[#f + 1] = S("tip", tip) end
  return node("button", f)
end
local function grid(cols, kids) return node("grid", { I("cols", cols), R("kids", arr(kids)) }) end
-- A pack image. The page resolves the src and drops the node when the file is not there, so an icon
-- that has not been generated yet costs nothing and never shows a broken frame.
local function image(src, size, alt)
  return node("image", with({ S("src", src), I("size", size or 64) }, alt and S("alt", alt) or nil))
end

-- Hero name -> the model it draws with, so a panel can name the icon that goes with it: the icons are
-- authored per model (icons/heroes/<model>.png), not per hero name.
local HERO_MODEL = nil
local function hero_model(name)
  if HERO_MODEL == nil then
    HERO_MODEL = {}
    for _, k in ipairs(game.unit_kinds()) do
      if k.player_controlled and k.model ~= "" then HERO_MODEL[k.name] = k.model end
    end
  end
  return HERO_MODEL[name]
end

-- The hero's icon image, or a label with the hero's name when the hero has no model to name its icon.
local function hero_icon(name, size)
  local model = hero_model(name)
  local icon = model and ("heroes/" .. model .. ".png") or nil
  if icon == nil then return label(name) end
  return image("icons/" .. icon, size or 48, name)
end

local function cell(kids, opts)
  opts = opts or {}
  local f = {}
  if opts.tone then f[#f + 1] = S("tone", opts.tone) end
  if opts.tip then f[#f + 1] = S("tip", opts.tip) end
  if opts.call then
    f[#f + 1] = S("call", opts.call)
    f[#f + 1] = R("args", opts.args or "{}")
  end
  f[#f + 1] = R("kids", arr(kids))
  return node("cell", f)
end
local function panel(title, kids) return node("panel", { S("title", title), R("kids", arr(kids)) }) end

-- A widget event for one panel: the tree goes out when it differs from the last one sent. nil tree closes the panel.
local function emit(id, slot, tree)
  local key = tree or "-"
  if (LAST[id] or "-") == key then return end
  LAST[id] = key
  if tree == nil then
    game.ui_event("widget", obj({ I("player", LOCAL), S("id", id), B("remove", true) }))
  else
    game.ui_event("widget", obj({ I("player", LOCAL), S("id", id), S("slot", slot), R("tree", tree) }))
  end
end

local function team_of(p) return UI.teams[p + 1] or 0 end

local function sides()
  local seen, out = {}, {}
  for _, t in ipairs(UI.teams) do
    if not seen[t] then
      seen[t] = true
      out[#out + 1] = t
    end
  end
  return out
end

-- The one team name: the lobby's, used by the lobby strips, the scoreboard and the end screen.
local function team_name(side)
  return TEXT.lobby.teamNames[side + 1] or (TEXT.teamLabel .. " " .. tostring(side))
end

local function alive_selection()
  local out = {}
  for _, id in ipairs(SEL) do
    if unit_alive(id) then out[#out + 1] = id end
  end
  return out
end

-- The first selected unit of seat `who` that is one of its heroes, or nil.
local function hero_of(who)
  return units.hero_of(SEL, who)
end

-- The first living hero of player p, or nil.
local function hero_unit(p)
  for _, id in ipairs(game.units(p)) do
    if units.is_hero(id) then return id end
  end
  return nil
end

-- Hero rows for the team strip: one per player slot, from the first hero the sim lists for it. A slot whose hero is gone
-- reads dead until the horn starts the next roster.
local function update_heroes()
  local living = {}
  for _, id in ipairs(game.units()) do
    if units.is_hero(id) then
      local p = unit_player(id)
      if living[p] == nil then living[p] = id end
    end
  end
  for p = 0, #UI.teams - 1 do
    local id = living[p]
    if id ~= nil then
      HEROES[p] = { id = id, state = "alive", hp = unit_hp(id) }
    elseif HEROES[p] ~= nil then
      HEROES[p].state = "dead"
    end
  end
end

local function shr(v, n)
  for _ = 1, n do v = math.floor(v / 2) end
  return v
end

local function pips(rank, max)
  local out = ""
  for i = 1, max do
    if i <= rank then out = out .. "●" else out = out .. "○" end
  end
  return out
end

local function clock_text()
  if HORN == nil then return TEXT.preMatch end
  local ticks = game.time() - HORN
  local total = math.floor(ticks / TICKS_PER_SECOND)
  local minutes = math.floor(total / 60)
  local secs = total - minutes * 60
  if secs < 10 then secs = "0" .. tostring(secs) end
  return tostring(minutes) .. ":" .. tostring(secs)
end

-- The HUD line: the primary selected unit's hp and the local seat's gold. The match clock is on the top strip (team_tree).
local function hud_tree()
  local primary = alive_selection()[1]
  local hp = nil
  if primary ~= nil then hp = unit_hp(primary) end
  local hp_text = TEXT.noValue
  if hp ~= nil and hp >= 0 then hp_text = tostring(math.floor(hp / config.FIX)) end
  return box({
    label(TEXT.hud.hp .. " " .. hp_text),
    label(TEXT.hud.gold .. " " .. tostring(game.gold(LOCAL))),
  }, "row")
end

-- The post-game rows, one per seat that has a start: kills, deaths, assists (the unit credits), gold (the seat's
-- resource A), xp and the item kinds held, each summed over the seat's unit slots. A dead unit keeps its tallies until
-- its slot respawns, so every unit slot counts. The item list is read only when with_items is set.
local function post_game_rows(with_items)
  local rows, by_player = {}, {}
  for p = 0, config.PLAYERS - 1 do
    if game.seat_start(p) ~= nil then
      local row = { player = p, kills = 0, deaths = 0, assists = 0, gold = game.gold(p), xp = 0, items = {} }
      rows[#rows + 1] = row
      by_player[p] = row
    end
  end
  for u = 0, get_unit_count() - 1 do
    local row = by_player[unit_player(u)]
    if row ~= nil then
      row.kills = row.kills + game.kills_of(u)
      row.deaths = row.deaths + game.deaths_of(u)
      row.assists = row.assists + game.credits_of(u)
      row.xp = row.xp + game.xp(u)
      if with_items then
        for _, it in ipairs(game.unit_items(u)) do row.items[#row.items + 1] = it.item end
      end
    end
  end
  return rows
end

local function win_tree()
  local side = game.winner()
  if side == nil or side < 0 then return nil end
  local kids = { label(team_name(side) .. " " .. TEXT.winner.suffix, "accent") }
  for _, row in ipairs(post_game_rows(true)) do
    local items = #row.items
    kids[#kids + 1] = label("P" .. tostring(row.player) .. "  " .. TEXT.post.kills .. " " .. tostring(row.kills) ..
      "  " .. TEXT.post.deaths .. " " .. tostring(row.deaths) .. "  " .. TEXT.post.assists .. " " .. tostring(row.assists) ..
      "  " .. TEXT.post.gold .. " " .. tostring(row.gold) .. "  " .. TEXT.post.xp .. " " .. tostring(row.xp) ..
      "  " .. TEXT.post.items .. " " .. tostring(items))
  end
  return box(kids, "col")
end

-- The top strip, Dota's format: each side's kills with the match clock between them. Heroes and seat gold are on the
-- Tab scoreboard (scoreboard_tree).
local function team_tree()
  local kills = {}
  for _, row in ipairs(post_game_rows(false)) do
    local side = team_of(row.player)
    kills[side] = (kills[side] or 0) + row.kills
  end
  local kids = {}
  for i, side in ipairs(sides()) do
    if i == 2 then kids[#kids + 1] = label(clock_text(), "muted") end
    kids[#kids + 1] = label(TEXT.killsLabel .. " " .. tostring(kills[side] or 0), "team" .. tostring(side))
  end
  if TEXT.menu ~= nil then
    for _, entry in ipairs({ "shop", "scoreboard", "controls" }) do
      kids[#kids + 1] = button(TEXT.menu[entry], "toggle", obj({ S("panel", entry) }), false, TEXT.menu[entry])
    end
  end
  return box(kids, "row")
end

-- The shop tags of an item: the bit of each name in UI.shopNames (items.osd's item_tags order), read by division.
local function shop_tags(tags)
  local names, bit = {}, 1
  for _, name in ipairs(UI.shopNames) do
    if math.floor(tags / bit) % 2 == 1 then names[#names + 1] = name end
    bit = bit * 2
  end
  return join(names, "/")
end

local function stats_text(stats)
  local parts = {}
  for name, v in pairs(stats) do
    local sign = v > 0 and "+" or ""
    parts[#parts + 1] = sign .. tostring(v) .. " " .. name
  end
  return join(parts, " ")
end

local function recipe_text(components)
  local names = {}
  for _, c in ipairs(components) do
    local part = game.item_info(c)
    names[#names + 1] = part and part.name or ("#" .. tostring(c))
  end
  return join(names, " + ")
end

-- The price the engine charges this hero for an item (store.lua acquire): the cost less the components its held copies
-- cover, each held copy claimed once and a missing component's own parts claimed in its place. The buy button and the
-- purchase read the same price, so the button is enabled exactly when the purchase is accepted.
local function net_price(unit, item, def)
  local pool = {}
  for _, row in ipairs(game.unit_items(unit)) do
    if row.slot ~= NEUTRAL_SLOT then pool[row.item] = (pool[row.item] or 0) + row.count end
  end
  for _, row in ipairs(game.unit_stash(unit)) do
    pool[row.item] = (pool[row.item] or 0) + row.count
  end
  local function claim(c)
    local saved = 0
    for _, part in ipairs(game.item_info(c).components) do
      if (pool[part] or 0) > 0 then
        pool[part] = pool[part] - 1
        saved = saved + game.item_info(part).cost
      else
        saved = saved + claim(part)
      end
    end
    return saved
  end
  return def.cost - claim(item)
end

local function shop_tree()
  local hero = hero_of(LOCAL)
  local gold = game.gold(LOCAL)
  local cards = {}
  local i = 0
  while true do
    local def = game.item_info(i)
    if def == nil then break end
    if def.tags ~= 0 then
      local price = hero ~= nil and net_price(hero, i, def) or def.cost
      local afford = gold >= price
      local kids = {
        label(def.name, "strong"),
        label(tostring(def.cost) .. TEXT.costSuffix, afford and "gold" or "bad"),
        label("[" .. shop_tags(def.tags) .. "]", "faint"),
      }
      local stats = stats_text(def.stats)
      if stats ~= "" then kids[#kids + 1] = label(stats, "muted") end
      if #def.components > 0 then kids[#kids + 1] = label(TEXT.recipePrefix .. recipe_text(def.components), "faint") end
      kids[#kids + 1] = button(TEXT.buy, "buy", obj({ I("item", i) }), hero == nil or not afford)
      cards[#cards + 1] = cell(kids, { tip = def.name })
    end
    i = i + 1
  end
  return panel(TEXT.shop.title .. "  " .. TEXT.goldLabel .. " " .. tostring(gold), { grid(2, cards) })
end

local function skills_tree(hero)
  local level = xp.character_level(hero)
  local spent = 0
  for s = 0, ABILITY_SLOTS - 1 do spent = spent + game.skill_rank(hero, s) end
  local points = level - spent
  local kids = { label(TEXT.skills.level .. " " .. tostring(level) .. "  " .. TEXT.skills.points .. " " .. tostring(points), "muted") }
  kids[#kids + 1] = label(TEXT.skills.abilities, "faint")
  for _, a in ipairs(game.unit_abilities(hero)) do
    local rank = game.skill_rank(hero, a.slot)
    local info = game.skill_info(hero, a.slot)
    local gate_text, ready, row_pips = TEXT.skills.none, false, ""
    if info ~= nil then
      row_pips = pips(rank, info.max_rank)
      if rank >= info.max_rank then
        gate_text = TEXT.skills.maxed
      else
        local gate = info.gates[rank + 1]
        gate_text = TEXT.skills.gate .. " " .. tostring(gate)
        ready = points > 0 and level >= gate
      end
    end
    kids[#kids + 1] = box({
      box({ label(a.name, "strong"), label(row_pips, "accent"), label(gate_text, "muted") }, "col"),
      button("+", "skill_up", obj({ I("slot", a.slot) }), not ready, TEXT.skills.up),
    }, "row")
  end
  kids[#kids + 1] = label(TEXT.skills.talents, "faint")
  local bits = game.upgrade_bits(hero)
  for tier = 1, #TALENT_LEVELS do
    local need = TALENT_LEVELS[tier]
    local picked = shr(bits, TALENT_FIRST_BIT + 2 * (tier - 1)) % 4
    local row = { label(TEXT.skills.needLevel .. " " .. tostring(need), level < need and "muted" or "accent") }
    for side = 0, 1 do
      local on = (side == 0 and picked % 2 == 1) or (side == 1 and picked >= 2)
      local side_name = side == 0 and TEXT.skills.talentLeft or TEXT.skills.talentRight
      row[#row + 1] = button(side_name .. (on and " [x]" or " +"), "talent",
        obj({ I("unit", hero), I("tier", tier - 1), I("side", side) }), picked ~= 0 or level < need,
        side_name .. ": " .. TEXT.skills.talentName)
    end
    kids[#kids + 1] = box(row, "row")
  end
  return panel(TEXT.skills.title, kids)
end

-- Ability keys in slot order: {key, slot} from setup's cast map. The swap goes through a local, one assignment at a
-- time: the host's Lua VM evaluates a multiple assignment (a, b = b, a) with the first target already written, which
-- duplicated entries in the bar.
local function cast_keys()
  local list = {}
  for key, slot in pairs(KEYS.cast or {}) do list[#list + 1] = { key = key, slot = slot } end
  for i = 2, #list do
    local j = i
    while j > 1 and list[j - 1].slot > list[j].slot do
      local held = list[j - 1]
      list[j - 1] = list[j]
      list[j] = held
      j = j - 1
    end
  end
  return list
end

local function ability_cell(hero, key, abilities)
  local a = abilities[key.slot]
  if a == nil then return cell({ label(key.key, "faint") }, { tone = "empty" }) end
  local rank = game.skill_rank(hero, key.slot)
  local info = game.skill_info(hero, key.slot)
  local ranked = info ~= nil and info.max_rank > 0
  local kids = { label(key.key, "accent"), label(a.name, "strong") }
  if ranked then
    kids[#kids + 1] = label(tostring(info.energies[math.max(rank, 1)]), "mp")
    kids[#kids + 1] = label(pips(rank, info.max_rank), "muted")
  end
  local tone = nil
  if a.cooldown > 0 then
    local tenths = math.floor(a.cooldown * 10 / TICKS_PER_SECOND)
    kids[#kids + 1] = label(tostring(math.floor(tenths / 10)) .. "." .. tostring(tenths - 10 * math.floor(tenths / 10)) .. TEXT.cooldownSuffix, "warn")
    -- Cooldown sweep: the bar is the share of the cooldown still to run (ticks left over ticks in full).
    local k = tostring(hero) .. ":" .. tostring(key.slot)
    if a.cooldown > (COOLDOWN_FULL[k] or 0) then COOLDOWN_FULL[k] = a.cooldown end
    local full = COOLDOWN_FULL[k]
    if ranked and info.cooldowns[math.max(rank, 1)] ~= nil and info.cooldowns[math.max(rank, 1)] > 0 then full = info.cooldowns[math.max(rank, 1)] end
    kids[#kids + 1] = bar(math.min(a.cooldown, full), full)
    tone = "muted"
  elseif rank == 0 then
    tone = "faint"
  end
  if a.cooldown > 0 or rank == 0 then return cell(kids, { tone = tone, tip = a.name }) end
  return cell(kids, { tone = tone, tip = a.name, call = "cast", args = obj({ I("slot", key.slot) }) })
end

local function select_tree()
  local sel = alive_selection()
  if #sel == 0 then
    return box({ cell({ label(TEXT.noValue, "faint") }, { tone = "empty" }), label(TEXT.noSelection, "muted") }, "row")
  end
  local primary = sel[1]
  local hero = units.is_hero(primary)
  local hp = unit_hp(primary)
  local peak = math.max(PEAK[primary] or 0, hp)
  PEAK[primary] = peak
  local name = game.unit_kind(primary) or TEXT.unitUnknown
  local face = TEXT.noValue
  if hero then face = "L" .. tostring(xp.character_level(primary)) end
  local info = {
    label(name, "accent"),
    label(TEXT.healthLabel .. " " .. tostring(math.floor(hp / config.FIX)) .. "/" .. tostring(math.floor(peak / config.FIX))),
    bar(math.max(hp, 0), peak, "hp"),
  }
  if hero then
    info[#info + 1] = label(TEXT.manaLabel .. " " .. tostring(game.mana(primary)) .. "/" .. tostring(game.max_mana(primary)))
    info[#info + 1] = bar(game.mana(primary), game.max_mana(primary), "mp")
  end
  local portrait = hero and hero_icon(name, 56) or nil
  local kids = { box({ cell(with({ label(face, "accent") }, portrait), { tone = "face" }), box(info, "col") }, "row") }
  if hero and unit_player(primary) == LOCAL then
    local abilities = {}
    for _, a in ipairs(game.unit_abilities(primary)) do abilities[a.slot] = a end
    local cells = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(cast_keys()) do cells[#cells + 1] = ability_cell(primary, key, abilities) end
    kids[#kids + 1] = box(cells, "row")
  end
  if #sel >= 2 then
    local tiles = {}
    for i = 1, math.min(#sel, GROUP_TILES) do
      local id = sel[i]
      local tile_hp = unit_hp(id)
      local tile_peak = math.max(PEAK[id] or 0, tile_hp)
      PEAK[id] = tile_peak
      tiles[#tiles + 1] = cell({ label(game.unit_kind(id) or TEXT.noValue, "muted"), bar(math.max(tile_hp, 0), tile_peak, "hp") },
        { tone = i == 1 and "active" or nil, call = "select", args = obj({ R("ids", arr({ tostring(id) })) }) })
    end
    if #sel > GROUP_TILES then tiles[#tiles + 1] = cell({ label(TEXT.groupMore .. tostring(#sel - GROUP_TILES), "muted") }, { tone = "empty" }) end
    kids[#kids + 1] = grid(6, tiles)
  end
  return box(kids, "col")
end

local function inventory_tree()
  local hero = hero_of(LOCAL)
  local items, stored = {}, {}
  if hero ~= nil then
    for _, row in ipairs(game.unit_items(hero)) do items[row.slot] = row.name end
    for _, row in ipairs(game.unit_stash(hero)) do stored[row.slot] = row.name end
  end
  if items[SELL_ARMED] == nil then SELL_ARMED = nil end
  local main, stash = {}, {}
  for s = 0, INVENTORY_SLOTS - 1 do
    local name = items[s]
    if name ~= nil then
      local armed = SELL_ARMED == s
      local tip = armed and TEXT.menu.sellConfirm or (TEXT.menu.sell .. " " .. name .. " (" .. TEXT.menu.refund .. " " .. TEXT.lobby.unverified .. ")")
      main[#main + 1] = cell({ label(name, "strong") }, { tip = tip, tone = armed and "active" or nil, call = "sell", args = obj({ I("slot", s) }) })
    else
      main[#main + 1] = cell({}, { tone = "empty" })
    end
  end
  for s = 0, STASH_SLOTS - 1 do
    local name = stored[s]
    if name ~= nil then
      stash[#stash + 1] = cell({ label(name, "strong") }, { tip = name, tone = "stash", call = "unstash", args = obj({ I("slot", s) }) })
    else
      stash[#stash + 1] = cell({}, { tone = "empty" })
    end
  end
  return box({
    box({ label(TEXT.inventoryLabel, "faint"), grid(3, main) }, "col"),
    box({ label(TEXT.stashLabel, "faint"), grid(3, stash) }, "col"),
  }, "row")
end

local inventory_cache = {}

-- The inventory tree is a function of the hero, its items and its stash: it is rebuilt only when the hero or the
-- hero's item generation moves.
local function inventory_tree_cached()
  local hero = hero_of(LOCAL)
  local gen = hero ~= nil and game.unit_item_gen(hero) or nil
  if gen ~= nil and inventory_cache.hero == hero and inventory_cache.gen == gen then return inventory_cache.tree end
  local tree = inventory_tree()
  inventory_cache = { hero = hero, gen = gen, tree = tree }
  return tree
end

-- One line of the controls list for a UI.keys entry: a list of keys, a key -> slot map, or a modifier with keys.
local function key_text(v)
  if type(v) ~= "table" then return tostring(v) end
  if v.modifier ~= nil then return v.modifier .. "+" .. key_text(v.keys) end
  local names = {}
  if v[1] ~= nil then
    for _, k in ipairs(v) do names[#names + 1] = tostring(k) end
  else
    for k in pairs(v) do names[#names + 1] = tostring(k) end
    for i = 2, #names do
      local j = i
      while j > 1 and names[j - 1] > names[j] do
        local held = names[j - 1]
        names[j - 1] = names[j]
        names[j] = held
        j = j - 1
      end
    end
  end
  return join(names, " ")
end

-- The controls panel: every entry of UI.keys, so a rebound or added key shows without a change here.
local function controls_tree()
  local names = {}
  for name in pairs(KEYS) do names[#names + 1] = name end
  for i = 2, #names do
    local j = i
    while j > 1 and names[j - 1] > names[j] do
      local held = names[j - 1]
      names[j - 1] = names[j]
      names[j] = held
      j = j - 1
    end
  end
  local kids = {}
  for _, name in ipairs(names) do
    kids[#kids + 1] = label(name .. ": " .. key_text(KEYS[name]), "muted")
  end
  kids[#kids + 1] = button(TEXT.menu.close, "toggle", obj({ S("panel", "controls") }))
  return panel(TEXT.menu.controlsTitle, kids)
end

local function scoreboard_tree()
  local rows = post_game_rows(false)
  local kids = {}
  for _, side in ipairs(sides()) do
    local cells = {}
    for _, h in ipairs(TEXT.scoreboardHeaders) do cells[#cells + 1] = label(h, "muted") end
    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
      if team_of(row.player) == side then
        local me = row.player == LOCAL
        local hero = hero_unit(row.player)
        local name = TEXT.noValue
        local level = TEXT.noValue
        if hero ~= nil then
          name = game.unit_kind(hero) or TEXT.noValue
          level = tostring(xp.character_level(hero))
        end
        local tone = me and "me" or nil
        cells[#cells + 1] = label("P" .. tostring(row.player) .. (me and " *" or ""), tone)
        cells[#cells + 1] = label(name, tone)
        cells[#cells + 1] = label(level, tone)
        cells[#cells + 1] = label(tostring(row.kills), tone)
        cells[#cells + 1] = label(tostring(row.deaths), tone)
        cells[#cells + 1] = label(tostring(row.assists), tone)
        cells[#cells + 1] = label(tostring(row.gold), tone)
      end
    end
    kids[#kids + 1] = label(team_name(side), "team" .. tostring(side))
    kids[#kids + 1] = grid(7, cells)
  end
  return panel(TEXT.scoreboardTitle, kids)
end

-- The heroes a seat can pick: the player-controlled kinds that have a model. A hero with no model is not offered (it
-- would not draw), so the pick list holds only heroes that can play; the page still fails loudly on one that is drawn.
local function roster_names()
  local out = {}
  for _, k in ipairs(game.unit_kinds()) do
    if k.player_controlled and k.model ~= "" then out[#out + 1] = k.name end
  end
  return out
end

local function owner_text(s)
  if s.owner == nil then return TEXT.lobby.owners.open end
  if s.owner == OWNER then return TEXT.lobby.owners.you end
  if s.bot then return TEXT.lobby.owners.computer end
  return TEXT.lobby.owners.other
end

local function seated(owner)
  for _, s in ipairs(LOBBY.slots) do
    if s.owner == owner then return true end
  end
  return false
end

local function all_ready()
  for _, s in ipairs(LOBBY.slots) do
    if not (s.owner and s.hero and s.ready) then return false end
  end
  return true
end

local function any_open()
  for _, s in ipairs(LOBBY.slots) do
    if s.owner == nil then return true end
  end
  return false
end

local function held(hero)
  for _, s in ipairs(LOBBY.slots) do
    if s.hero == hero then return true end
  end
  return false
end

local function lobby_started_event()
  local items = {}
  for _, s in ipairs(LOBBY.slots) do
    items[#items + 1] = obj({ S("owner", s.owner or ""), S("hero", s.hero or "") })
  end
  game.ui_event("lobby", obj({ I("player", LOCAL), B("started", true), R("slots", arr(items)) }))
end

-- The seats before the match starts, after each lobby change: whether each seat is ready and which hero's model it
-- will play. The page parses a readied hero's model now, so the match starts without waiting on the download.
local function lobby_seats_event()
  local items = {}
  for _, s in ipairs(LOBBY.slots) do
    items[#items + 1] = obj({ S("owner", s.owner or ""), S("hero", s.hero or ""), B("ready", s.ready == true), S("model", s.hero and hero_model(s.hero) or "") })
  end
  game.ui_event("lobby", obj({ I("player", LOCAL), B("started", false), R("slots", arr(items)) }))
end

-- One lobby action on the shared state: the rules of the hero select. Slots are 0-based in the calls, as the sim counts.
local function lobby_act(call, a)
  local L = LOBBY
  -- The sender: a joined page's key rides on its action (applyPeerAction); the host's own presses use OWNER.
  local owner = a.pubkey or OWNER
  if L.started then
    L.error = "match-started"
    return
  end
  L.error = ""
  if call == "world_ready" then
    if owner ~= OWNER then L.error = "not-host" return end
    L.worldReady = true
    return
  end
  if call == "start" then
    if L.host ~= owner then L.error = "not-host" return end
    if not L.worldReady then L.error = "world-loading" return end
    if not all_ready() then L.error = "not-ready" return end
    L.started = true
    HEROES = {}
    HORN = game.time()
    lobby_started_event()
    return
  end
  if call == "fill" then
    if L.host ~= owner then L.error = "not-host" return end
    if not any_open() then L.error = "nothing-to-fill" return end
    if #ROSTER == 0 then L.error = "no-roster" return end
    for i = 1, SLOT_COUNT do
      local s = L.slots[i]
      if s.owner == nil then
        local hero = ROSTER[1]
        for _, h in ipairs(ROSTER) do
          if not held(h) then
            hero = h
            break
          end
        end
        s.owner = "bot:" .. tostring(i - 1)
        s.bot = true
        s.hero = hero
        s.ready = true
      end
    end
    return
  end
  local i = (a.slot or -1) + 1
  if i < 1 or i > SLOT_COUNT then L.error = "bad-slot" return end
  local s = L.slots[i]
  if call == "claim" then
    if s.owner ~= nil then L.error = "slot-taken" return end
    if seated(owner) then L.error = "already-seated" return end
    s.owner = owner
    s.bot = false
    if L.host == nil then L.host = owner end
  elseif call == "release" then
    if s.owner ~= owner then L.error = "not-owner" return end
    s.owner, s.hero, s.ready, s.bot = nil, nil, false, false
    if L.host == owner then
      L.host = nil
      for _, other in ipairs(L.slots) do
        if other.owner ~= nil and not other.bot then
          L.host = other.owner
          break
        end
      end
    end
  elseif call == "remove" then
    if L.host ~= owner then L.error = "not-host" return end
    if s.owner == nil then L.error = "slot-empty" return end
    local removed = s.owner
    s.owner, s.hero, s.ready, s.bot = nil, nil, false, false
    if L.host == removed then
      L.host = nil
      for _, other in ipairs(L.slots) do
        if other.owner ~= nil and not other.bot then
          L.host = other.owner
          break
        end
      end
    end
  elseif call == "pick" then
    if s.owner ~= owner then L.error = "not-owner" return end
    if s.ready then L.error = "ready-locked" return end
    local known = false
    for _, h in ipairs(ROSTER) do
      if h == a.hero then known = true end
    end
    if not known then L.error = "unknown-hero" return end
    for j, other in ipairs(L.slots) do
      if j ~= i and other.hero == a.hero then L.error = "hero-held" return end
    end
    s.hero = a.hero
  elseif call == "ready" then
    if s.owner ~= owner then L.error = "not-owner" return end
    if a.ready and s.hero == nil then L.error = "no-hero" return end
    s.ready = a.ready == true
  end
end

-- The tone of a seat's state: open (faint), seated but not ready (warn), ready (ok). owner_text and readySuffix say the same in words.
local function seat_tone(s)
  if s.owner == nil then return "faint" end
  if s.ready then return "ok" end
  return "warn"
end
