-- The largest base of each attribute over the roster: the full scale of the stat bars.
local function base_max()
  local best = { 0, 0, 0 }
  for _, name in ipairs(ROSTER) do
    local e = HERO_BASE[name]
    if e ~= nil then
      for k = 1, 3 do
        if e[2 * k] > best[k] then best[k] = e[2 * k] end
      end
    end
  end
  return best
end

local function my_seat()
  for i = 1, SLOT_COUNT do
    if LOBBY.slots[i].owner == OWNER then return i end
  end
  return nil
end

-- A roster hero no seat holds, chosen by the game clock; nil when every hero is held.
local function random_free()
  local free = {}
  for _, h in ipairs(ROSTER) do
    if not held(h) then free[#free + 1] = h end
  end
  if #free == 0 then return nil end
  return free[(game.time() % #free) + 1]
end

-- One seat in the top strip: its head, its hero and its claim or leave button. Seats in the strip never pick.
local function lobby_seat(i)
  local s = LOBBY.slots[i]
  local slot0 = i - 1
  local head = TEXT.lobby.slotWord .. " " .. tostring(i) .. ": " .. owner_text(s)
  local kids = {}
  local icon = s.hero and hero_icon(s.hero, 40) or nil
  if icon ~= nil then kids[#kids + 1] = icon end
  local tail = ""
  if s.ready then tail = TEXT.lobby.readySuffix end
  local name = TEXT.lobby.noHero
  if s.hero then
    name = hero_name(s.hero)
  elseif s.owner == OWNER then
    name = TEXT.lobby.pickHero
  end
  kids[#kids + 1] = label(head, seat_tone(s))
  kids[#kids + 1] = label(name .. tail, seat_tone(s))
  if s.owner == nil then
    kids[#kids + 1] = button(TEXT.lobby.claim, "claim", obj({ I("slot", slot0) }), seated(OWNER))
  elseif s.owner == OWNER then
    kids[#kids + 1] = button(TEXT.lobby.leave, "release", obj({ I("slot", slot0) }))
  elseif LOBBY.host == OWNER then
    kids[#kids + 1] = button(TEXT.lobby.remove, "remove", obj({ I("slot", slot0) }))
  end
  return box(kids, "col")
end

-- A hero tile in the centre grid: a portrait with its acronym as the badge and no name under it (the name is on the
-- right card and the seat strip). Only a seat's own tile picks, and only while that seat is unready.
local function hero_tile(name, mine)
  local shown = hero_name(name)
  local own = mine ~= nil and LOBBY.slots[mine].hero == name
  local faint = not own and held(name)
  local f = { S("alt", shown), S("badge", acronym(shown)), S("text", ""), S("tip", shown) }
  local model = hero_model(name)
  if model then f[#f + 1] = S("src", "icons/heroes/" .. model .. ".png") end
  if own then f[#f + 1] = B("selected", true) end
  if faint then f[#f + 1] = S("tone", "faint") end
  if mine ~= nil and not LOBBY.slots[mine].ready and not faint then
    f[#f + 1] = S("call", "pick")
    f[#f + 1] = R("args", obj({ I("slot", mine - 1), S("hero", name) }))
  end
  return obj(f)
end

-- The centre grid: one labelled column per primary attribute (Strength, Agility, Intelligence) in a regions container
-- (side by side on a wide screen, swipeable on a narrow one), each holding its portraits sized to fit. Heroes with no
-- verified attribute (UNVERIFIED) go in a row of their own under the columns.
local function attribute_rows(mine)
  local groups = { {}, {}, {}, {} }
  for _, name in ipairs(ROSTER) do
    local g = hero_group(name)
    if g == 0 then g = 4 end
    groups[g][#groups[g] + 1] = name
  end
  local function tiles_of(g)
    local tiles = {}
    for _, name in ipairs(groups[g]) do tiles[#tiles + 1] = hero_tile(name, mine) end
    return tiles
  end
  local kids = {}
  for g = 1, 3 do
    kids[#kids + 1] = box({ label(TEXT.lobby.attrs[g], "accent"), node("portraits", { I("cols", 8), B("fit", true), R("items", arr(tiles_of(g))) }) }, "col")
  end
  local rows = { node("regions", { S("dir", "row"), B("swipe", true), R("kids", arr(kids)) }) }
  if #groups[4] > 0 then
    rows[#rows + 1] = box({ label(TEXT.lobby.attrs[4], "muted"), node("portraits", { I("cols", 8), I("size", 56), R("items", arr(tiles_of(4))) }) }, "row")
  end
  return rows
end

-- One team's strip: its name, how many seats are filled, and its seats.
local function team_strip(t)
  local seats, filled = {}, 0
  for i = 1, TEAM_SIZE do
    local slot = t * TEAM_SIZE + i
    seats[#seats + 1] = lobby_seat(slot)
    if LOBBY.slots[slot].owner ~= nil then filled = filled + 1 end
  end
  return box({
    label(TEXT.lobby.teamNames[t + 1], "accent"),
    bar(filled, TEAM_SIZE, t == 0 and "accent" or "warn"),
    box(seats, "row"),
  }, "col")
end

-- The right card for the local seat: its hero's portrait, name, stat bars and roles, then Lock In and Random.
local function hero_card(mine)
  local kids = { label(TEXT.lobby.chooseHero, "accent") }
  if mine == nil then
    kids[#kids + 1] = label(TEXT.lobby.noSeat, "muted")
    return box(kids, "col")
  end
  local s = LOBBY.slots[mine]
  if s.hero == nil then
    kids[#kids + 1] = label(TEXT.lobby.pickHero, "muted")
  else
    local icon = hero_icon(s.hero, 128)
    if icon ~= nil then kids[#kids + 1] = icon end
    kids[#kids + 1] = label(hero_name(s.hero), nil)
    local base = HERO_BASE[s.hero]
    if base == nil then
      kids[#kids + 1] = label(TEXT.lobby.attrs[4], "muted")
    else
      local max = base_max()
      for k = 1, 3 do
        kids[#kids + 1] = label(TEXT.lobby.attrs[k], nil)
        kids[#kids + 1] = bar(base[2 * k], max[k], "ok")
      end
    end
  end
  for _, role in ipairs(TEXT.lobby.roles) do
    kids[#kids + 1] = label(role .. ": " .. TEXT.lobby.unverified, "faint")
  end
  local lock_text = TEXT.lobby.lockIn
  if s.ready then lock_text = TEXT.lobby.unready end
  kids[#kids + 1] = button(lock_text, "ready", obj({ I("slot", mine - 1), B("ready", not s.ready) }), not s.ready and s.hero == nil)
  local free = random_free()
  kids[#kids + 1] = button(TEXT.lobby.random, "pick", obj({ I("slot", mine - 1), S("hero", free or "") }), s.ready or free == nil)
  return box(kids, "col")
end

-- The bottom bar's team composition: each team's picked heroes.
local function composition()
  local parts = {}
  for t = 0, 1 do
    local names = {}
    for i = 1, TEAM_SIZE do
      local s = LOBBY.slots[t * TEAM_SIZE + i]
      if s.hero then names[#names + 1] = hero_name(s.hero) end
    end
    parts[#parts + 1] = TEXT.lobby.teamNames[t + 1] .. ": " .. join(names, ", ")
  end
  return TEXT.lobby.composition .. ": " .. join(parts, "  |  ")
end

local function lobby_tree()
  if LOBBY.started then return nil end
  local mine = my_seat()
  local ready = 0
  for _, s in ipairs(LOBBY.slots) do
    if s.owner and s.ready then ready = ready + 1 end
  end
  local status = tostring(ready) .. "/" .. tostring(SLOT_COUNT) .. " " .. TEXT.lobby.readyWord
  if LOBBY.error ~= "" then
    local why = TEXT.lobby.refusals[LOBBY.error] or TEXT.lobby.refusedGeneric
    status = status .. " (" .. TEXT.lobby.refusedWord .. ": " .. why .. ")"
  end
  local host = LOBBY.host == OWNER
  return panel(TEXT.lobby.title, {
    box({ team_strip(0), team_strip(1) }, "row"),
    box({ box(attribute_rows(mine), "col"), hero_card(mine) }, "row"),
    box({
      label(composition(), "muted"),
      label(status, "muted"),
      button(TEXT.lobby.fillBots, "fill", "{}", not (host and any_open())),
      button(LOBBY.worldReady and TEXT.lobby.startMatch or TEXT.lobby.loadingWorld, "start", "{}", not (host and all_ready() and LOBBY.worldReady)),
    }, "row"),
  })
end

local function emit_all()
  update_heroes()
  emit("lobby", "modal", lobby_tree())
  emit("hud", "hud", hud_tree())
  emit("win", "win", win_tree())
  emit("team", "top", team_tree())
  emit("scoreboard", "centre", OPEN.scoreboard and scoreboard_tree() or nil)
  emit("shop", "right", OPEN.shop and shop_tree() or nil)
  emit("controls", "centre", OPEN.controls and TEXT.menu ~= nil and controls_tree() or nil)
  local hero = hero_of(LOCAL)
  emit("skills", "left", hero ~= nil and skills_tree(hero) or nil)
  emit("inventory", "bar-mid", inventory_tree_cached())
  emit("select", "bar-left", select_tree())
end

local function key_in(list, key)
  for _, k in ipairs(list or {}) do
    if k == key then return true end
  end
  return false
end

local function ui_call(who, call, a)
  if call == "buy" then
    local hero = hero_of(who)
    if hero ~= nil then game.cmd_buy(hero, a.item) end
  elseif call == "toggle" then
    if OPEN[a.panel] ~= nil then OPEN[a.panel] = not OPEN[a.panel] end
  elseif call == "sell" then
    local hero = hero_of(who)
    if hero ~= nil and SELL_ARMED == a.slot then
      SELL_ARMED = nil
      game.cmd_sell(hero, a.slot)
    elseif hero ~= nil then
      SELL_ARMED = a.slot
      inventory_cache = {}
    end
  elseif call == "unstash" then
    local hero = hero_of(who)
    if hero ~= nil then game.cmd_unstash(hero, a.slot) end
  elseif call == "skill_up" then
    local hero = hero_of(who)
    if hero ~= nil then game.cmd_skill_up(hero, a.slot) end
  elseif call == "claim" or call == "release" or call == "remove" or call == "pick" or call == "ready" or call == "fill" or call == "start" or call == "world_ready" then
    lobby_act(call, a)
    if call ~= "start" then lobby_seats_event() end
    if call == "world_ready" then emit("lobby", "modal", lobby_tree()) end
  end
end

local function panels_on_action(name, args)
  if name == "setup" then
    UI = args.ui or {}
    TEXT = UI.text or {}
    KEYS = UI.keys or {}
    LOCAL = args.player or LOCAL
    OWNER = args.pubkey or OWNER
    LAST = {}
    inventory_cache = {}
  elseif name == "key" then
    if args.phase == "down" and (args.player == nil or args.player == LOCAL) then
      if key_in(KEYS.shop, args.key) then OPEN.shop = not OPEN.shop end
      if key_in(KEYS.scoreboard, args.key) then OPEN.scoreboard = not OPEN.scoreboard end
      if key_in(KEYS.controls, args.key) then OPEN.controls = not OPEN.controls end
    end
  elseif name == "selection" then
    if args.player == nil or args.player == LOCAL then SEL = args.ids or {} end
  elseif name == "ui" then
    local a = args.args or {}
    a.pubkey = args.pubkey
    ui_call(args.player or LOCAL, args.call, a)
  end
end

local function refresh()
  if ROSTER == nil then
    if UI.teams == nil then return end
    ROSTER = roster_names()
  end
  if TEXT.lobby == nil then return end
  emit_all()
end

-- Every REFRESH_TICKS ticks from the first tick: the panels that changed go out again.
game.timer("panels", 1, refresh, REFRESH_TICKS)

return { on_action = panels_on_action }

name: kill_gold.lua
text:
-- Moba kill gold, as mod code, 1:1 with Dota: gold comes from kills by heroes. A unit with a bounty pays it when a hero kills
-- it: the killing hero keeps the bounty less the team share, and its side gets the share. A creep or tower killing a
-- creep (or a building) earns no gold, and neither does an attackerless death or a denial (the killer is allied to the
-- victim). A hero killed by a creep or a tower pays the enemy heroes in heroes.lua. The payout is core/bounty.lua's; this
-- file sets the rule.
local bounty = require("bounty")
local aegis = require("aegis")

local TEAM_SHARE_PCT = 20
local NEUTRAL = 255 -- the neutral player (the sim's NEUTRAL_PLAYER)
local MAX_PLAYERS = 16 -- the sim's player slots

game.trigger("on_died", {
  conditions = { function(_, _, _, amount) return amount > 0 end },
  action = function(unit, killer, killer_player, amount, victim_player, killer_attributed)
    if aegis.reincarnating(unit) then return end
    if killer ~= nil and killer ~= unit and not game.alive(killer) then
      -- The killer died in the same step: a hero's kill still pays its side, and no dead unit takes it.
      if killer_attributed and killer_player ~= NEUTRAL and game.hostile(killer_player, victim_player) then
        bounty.pay({ unit = unit, side = killer_player, gold = amount, text = true })
      end
      return
    end
    if killer ~= nil and killer ~= unit then
      -- Only a hero's kill pays (Dota): a creep, a tower or a neutral camp creep pays nothing.
      if not killer_attributed or killer_player == NEUTRAL or not game.hostile(killer_player, victim_player) then return end
      bounty.pay({ unit = unit, side = killer_player, killer = killer, gold = amount, share_pct = TEAM_SHARE_PCT,
        to_unit = killer_attributed, text = true })
      return
    end
    -- An attackerless death earns no gold (Dota pays for kills by heroes only).
  end,
})

return {}

name: taunt.lua
text:
-- Taunt as mod code: a taunted unit walks to the unit that taunted it. The engine keeps the TAUNT
-- countdown and the taunter record as generic status (the way it keeps stun and root). game.taunter(unit)
-- reads them: it returns the taunter's unit id while the TAUNT status runs and the taunter lives, else nil.
--
-- The forced strike target (the engine's taunt_target, read when a unit picks what to strike) is not
-- ported here: the engine has no hook that asks the mod for a strike target. See the port report.

return {
  on_tick = function()
    for i = 0, get_unit_count() - 1 do
      if unit_alive(i) then
        local taunter = game.taunter(i)
        if taunter ~= nil then
          local tx, ty = unit_position(taunter)
          game.cmd_order(i, tx, ty)
        end
      end
    end
  end,
}

name: levelup.lua
text:
-- Hero level-up as mod code. The engine gives no stats on a level gain: it only raises the xp counter. This
-- file reads xp.level_of for each hero every tick (the same read effects.lua uses for the level-up effect),
-- and on a gain re-derives the hero's attribute stats through game.refresh_attr_stats(unit).
--
-- game.refresh_attr_stats is a required native (not yet in the engine). The stat formula it stands for is
-- not ported to Lua here; see the port report.

local units = require("units")
local xp = require("xp")

local seen_level = {}  -- hero unit -> level at the last tick

return {
  on_tick = function()
    for i = 0, get_unit_count() - 1 do
      if units.is_hero(i) then
        local level = xp.level_of(i)
        local before = seen_level[i]
        if before ~= nil and level > before then
          game.refresh_attr_stats(i)
        end
        seen_level[i] = level
      end
    end
  end,
}

name: upgrades.lua
text:
-- Moba upgrades: Aghanim's Scepter and Aghanim's Shard. The sim keeps only the upgrade bits
-- (game.set_upgrade_bit, game.upgrade_bits); which item sets which bit, and when, is this file.
-- Bit 0 is the scepter, bit 1 the shard; talents.lua owns bits 2..=9.
--
-- Uses game.set_upgrade_bit(unit, bit, on), game.units(), game.unit_items(unit) (the active-slot items
-- of a unit, each with name and count), game.unit_item_gen(unit) and the on_cast and on_tick hooks.

local SCEPTER_BIT = 0
local SHARD_BIT = 1

-- Items spent on use: the cast sets the bit.
local ON_USE = {
  item_ultimate_scepter_2 = SCEPTER_BIT,
  item_aghanims_shard = SHARD_BIT,
}

-- Items that set a bit while carried in an active slot, and clear it when put away.
local HELD = {
  ultimate_scepter = SCEPTER_BIT,
}

local HELD_BITS = { SCEPTER_BIT }

-- held[unit][bit] is true while the unit carries an item that sets the bit, as on_tick last saw it.
local held = {}
-- seen[unit] is the item generation held[unit] was read at: the items are scanned again only when it moves.
local seen = {}

local function carried_bits(unit)
  local bits = {}
  for _, item in ipairs(game.unit_items(unit)) do
    local bit = HELD[item.name]
    if bit ~= nil then bits[bit] = true end
  end
  return bits
end

return {
  on_state_replaced = function()
    held, seen = {}, {}
  end,

  on_cast = function(caster, ability)
    local bit = ON_USE[ability]
    if bit ~= nil then game.set_upgrade_bit(caster, bit, true) end
  end,

  on_tick = function(state)
    local live = {}
    for _, unit in ipairs(game.units()) do
      live[unit] = true
      local gen = game.unit_item_gen(unit)
      if held[unit] == nil or seen[unit] ~= gen then
        local now = carried_bits(unit)
        local before = held[unit] or {}
        for _, bit in ipairs(HELD_BITS) do
          local has, had = now[bit] == true, before[bit] == true
          if has ~= had then game.set_upgrade_bit(unit, bit, has) end
        end
        held[unit] = now
        seen[unit] = gen
      end
    end
    for unit in pairs(held) do
      if not live[unit] then
        held[unit] = nil
        seen[unit] = nil
      end
    end
  end,
}

name: targeting.lua
text:
-- Auto-target and aggro rules of the moba pack: the target class order a unit prefers, the aggro redirect an armed
-- structure takes when an allied unit is hit, the strike a unit makes when it is attacked, and the action a fired
-- behaviour takes. The sim keeps the state these set (the class override, the aggro target and its hold, the queued
-- behaviours); the rules themselves are here.

local config = require("config")
local units = require("units")

local targeting = {}

-- TARGETS in the data format: none, unit, point.
local TARGET_UNIT = 1
-- ORDERS in the data format (sim ORDER_ATTACK_MOVE): the order an attack-move unit holds and strikes on.
local ORDER_ATTACK_MOVE = 2


local function within(a, b, range)
  local ax, ay = unit_position(a)
  local bx, by = unit_position(b)
  local dx, dy = ax - bx, ay - by
  return dx * dx + dy * dy <= range * range
end


-- Priority class of candidate `cand` for attacker `att`; lower is preferred. A unit attacker takes plain units,
-- then units, then structures. An armed structure takes its aggro target while it is held (`held`), then plain
-- units, units, structures. Within one class the nearest target wins. Off unless the rule aggro_priority is 1.
function targeting.target_class_order(att, cand, held)
  local forced = game.class_override(att)
  if forced >= 0 then return forced end
  if config.rule("aggro_priority") ~= 1 then return 0 end
  if units.is_hero(att) then return 0 end
  local cand_hero = units.is_hero(cand)
  local plain = not cand_hero and not units.is_structure(cand)
  if units.is_structure(att) then
    if held then return 0 end
    if plain then return 1 end
    if cand_hero then return 2 end
    return 3
  end
  if plain then return 0 end
  if cand_hero then return 1 end
  return 2
end


-- Every armed non-unit unit on the victim's side that reaches the victim takes the attacker as its aggro target for
-- aggro_hold_s seconds. Runs for each hit between two heroes of hostile sides.
function targeting.aggro_redirect(attacker, victim)
  -- The host passes attacker -1 when a hit has no unit behind it: there is nothing to redirect to.
  if attacker < 0 or config.rule("aggro_priority") ~= 1 or attacker == victim then return end
  if not units.is_hero(victim) or not units.is_hero(attacker) then return end
  local side = unit_player(victim)
  if not units.hostile(side, unit_player(attacker)) then return end
  local hold = config.rule("aggro_hold_s") * config.TICKS_PER_SECOND
  for u = 0, get_unit_count() - 1 do
    if unit_alive(u) and unit_player(u) == side and not units.is_hero(u) then
      local damage, range = game.weapon(u)
      if damage > 0 and within(u, victim, range) then
        game.set_aggro(u, attacker, hold)
      end
    end
  end
end


-- The nearest enemy unit `unit` can strike within its weapon reach, lowest unit id on a tie; nil when none.
function targeting.nearest_enemy(unit)
  local _, range = game.weapon(unit)
  local x, y = unit_position(unit)
  local best, best_d
  for _, j in ipairs(units.units_near(x, y, range)) do
    if j ~= unit and units.hostile(unit_player(unit), unit_player(j)) and game.can_target(unit, j) then
      local jx, jy = unit_position(j)
      local dx, dy = jx - x, jy - y
      local d = dx * dx + dy * dy
      if best == nil or d < best_d then best, best_d = j, d end
    end
  end
  return best
end


-- A behaviour the sim fired. use_ability casts the ability in its slot: at the nearest enemy in reach when the
-- ability takes a unit (skipped when there is none), else at the caster's own position.
function targeting.fired_action(unit, trigger, action, ability, slot, target_kind)
  if action ~= "use_ability" then return end
  local target = -1
  if target_kind == TARGET_UNIT then
    target = targeting.nearest_enemy(unit)
    if target == nil then return end
  end
  local x, y = unit_position(unit)
  game.cmd_cast(unit, slot, target, x, y)
end


-- One tick reads every living unit's position once and buckets the living by the cell they stand in, so a choice
-- reads only the cells its reach covers instead of asking the sim for a table of every living unit: one such table
-- per unit per tick is the pack's heaviest per-tick cost. The cells hold the same candidates in another order, so
-- the choice names the lowest id itself where the sim's own list used to break a tie by the order it came back in.
local CELL = 262144                    -- the side of a bucket square, in fixed point
local PX, PY = {}, {}                  -- the position of each living unit, as this tick read it
local GRID = {}                        -- cell column -> cell row -> the living ids standing in that cell
local BUCKETS_FOR = -1                 -- the tick the buckets were built for

-- Buckets the living units by cell, once a tick. Only a step moves a unit, so the tick's own read is the scan's.
local function bucket_units()
  local tick = game.ticks()
  if tick == BUCKETS_FOR then return end
  BUCKETS_FOR = tick
  GRID = {}
  for u = 0, get_unit_count() - 1 do
    if unit_alive(u) then
      local x, y = unit_position(u)
      PX[u], PY[u] = x, y
      local cx, cy = math.floor(x / CELL), math.floor(y / CELL)
      local col = GRID[cx]
      if col == nil then col = {} GRID[cx] = col end
      local cell = col[cy]
      if cell == nil then cell = {} col[cy] = cell end
      cell[#cell + 1] = u
    end
  end
end

-- The target `unit` takes out of the cells its reach covers: the sim's own terms (can_target) and the class order
-- decide who may be struck, the nearest within a class wins, and the lowest id wins a tie of class and distance.
local function best_in_reach(unit, x, y, range, aggro)
  range = math.max(range, 0)
  local r2, best, best_class, best_d = range * range, -1, nil, nil
  local cx0, cx1 = math.floor((x - range) / CELL), math.floor((x + range) / CELL)
  local cy0, cy1 = math.floor((y - range) / CELL), math.floor((y + range) / CELL)
  for cx = cx0, cx1 do
    local col = GRID[cx]
    if col ~= nil then
      for cy = cy0, cy1 do
        local cell = col[cy]
        if cell ~= nil then
          for _, j in ipairs(cell) do
            local dx, dy = PX[j] - x, PY[j] - y
            local d = dx * dx + dy * dy
            if d <= r2 and game.can_target(unit, j) then
              local class = targeting.target_class_order(unit, j, aggro == j)
              if best_class == nil or class < best_class
                or (class == best_class and (d < best_d or (d == best_d and j < best))) then
                best, best_class, best_d = j, class, d
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return best
end

-- The enemy `unit` strikes this tick, -1 for none. A unit that deals no damage strikes nothing. A taunter in reach is
-- struck first; then the enemy struck last while it stays valid (sticky); otherwise the best class in reach
-- (target_class_order), the nearest within a class, the lowest id on a tie.
function targeting.strike_choice(unit)
  local damage, range = game.weapon(unit)
  if damage <= 0 then return -1 end
  local taunter = game.taunter(unit)
  if taunter ~= nil and within(unit, taunter, range) and game.can_target(unit, taunter) then return taunter end
  local last = game.strike_of(unit)
  if last >= 0 and unit_alive(last) and within(unit, last, range) and game.can_target(unit, last) then return last end
  local x, y = unit_position(unit)
  bucket_units()
  return -1
end


-- Hook handlers: the host calls on_tick, on_hit, on_attacked and on_behaviour; the rest of the module is the rules above.
-- Each tick every unit sets the enemy it strikes; the sim strikes it when it is still in reach. An attack-move unit
-- strikes only a foe it can damage (strike_lands), and holds its tile only while it can strike that foe (can_strike).
function targeting.on_tick()
  for u = 0, get_unit_count() - 1 do
    if unit_alive(u) then
      local target = targeting.strike_choice(u)
      if game.order_of(u) == ORDER_ATTACK_MOVE then
        if target >= 0 and not game.strike_lands(target) then target = -1 end
        game.set_attack_hold(u, target >= 0 and game.can_strike(u, target))
      end
      game.cmd_strike(u, target)
    end
  end
end

function targeting.on_state_replaced()
  BUCKETS_FOR = -1
end

function targeting.on_hit(attacker, victim)
  targeting.aggro_redirect(attacker, victim)
end

function targeting.on_attacked(unit)
  local target = targeting.nearest_enemy(unit)
  if target ~= nil then game.cmd_attack(unit, target) end
end

function targeting.on_behaviour(unit, trigger, action, ability, slot, target_kind)
  targeting.fired_action(unit, trigger, action, ability, slot, target_kind)
end


return targeting

name: unit_rules.lua
text:
-- Per-unit combat and movement rules, as mod code: the damage a unit takes (its armour curve), the speed it can hold
-- (the speed limits of the reference, against its type's own base), and the chance its shots miss (a melee shot never
-- misses). The sim keeps the values this sets and applies them: each tick, to the next one. The numbers are attr rules.
local config = require("config")

local ONE = 65536 -- Q16.16 one
local MAX = 2147483647
local K = config.rule("armour_per_point_q16")
local SPEED_MAX = config.rule("move_speed_max")
local SPEED_MIN = config.rule("move_speed_min")
local SPEED_POINT = config.rule("speed_point_q16")
local MELEE = config.rule("melee_range_q16")
local MAGIC_RESIST = 11 -- the stat code of magic resistance (sim spell.rs S_MAGIC_RESIST)
local DAMAGE_REDUCTION = 30 -- the stat code of damage reduction (sim spell.rs S_DAMAGE_REDUCTION)
local REDUCED_RESPONSE = 1 -- the damage response kinds of the unit data (sim combat.rs response_of): reduced, and immune
local IMMUNE_RESPONSE = 2
local REDUCED_PCT = config.rule("reduced_response_pct")

-- Integer division truncating toward zero, the sim's own division.
local function tdiv(a, b)
  local q = math.abs(a) // math.abs(b)
  if (a < 0) ~= (b < 0) then q = -q end
  return q
end

-- A milli-unit value in Q16.16 (the sim's own conversion).
local function from_milli(m) return tdiv(m * ONE, 1000) end

-- The damage scale (Q16.16) of an armour value: 1 - k*a / (1 + k*|a|). Armour never reaches zero, and negative armour
-- raises damage.
local function armour_scale(armour)
  local ka = (K * armour) // ONE
  return ONE - tdiv(ka * ONE, ONE + math.abs(ka))
end

-- The percent of magical damage a unit keeps: its base magic resistance and its bonus, stacked multiplicatively.
local function magic_keep(u)
  local base = game.magic_base(u)
  local bonus = game.stat_value(u, MAGIC_RESIST)
  return tdiv((100 - base) * (100 - bonus), 100)
end

-- The percent of every hit a unit keeps through its damage reduction stat (the stat clamped to plus or minus 100).
local function damage_keep(u)
  local reduction = math.max(-100, math.min(100, game.stat_value(u, DAMAGE_REDUCTION)))
  return 100 - reduction
end

-- The percent of every hit a unit keeps through its damage response: nothing when immune, the rule's percent when reduced.
local function response_keep(u)
  local kind = game.response_of(u)
  if kind == IMMUNE_RESPONSE then return 0 end
  if kind == REDUCED_RESPONSE then return REDUCED_PCT end
  return 100
end

-- The speed bounds (floor, cap) of a unit in Q16.16 per tick: at most the reference's maximum, or the unit type's own
-- base when that is higher; at least the reference's minimum, or the unit's own speed when that is lower. A unit with
-- no speed of its own has no bounds.
local function speed_bounds(u)
  local own = game.unit_speed(u)
  if own <= 0 then return 0, MAX end
  local type_base = from_milli(game.type_speed(u))
  return math.min(SPEED_MIN * SPEED_POINT, own), math.max(SPEED_MAX * SPEED_POINT, type_base)
end

-- The last value each setter received for each unit. A setter is called only when its value moved, so a unit whose
-- rules are unchanged costs no native calls on a tick.
local applied = {}

-- Sets one field through its setter when the value differs from the last one applied to the unit.
local function set_once(u, key, value, setter, ...)
  local rec = applied[u]
  if not rec then rec = {}; applied[u] = rec end
  if rec[key] == value then return end
  rec[key] = value
  setter(u, value, ...)
end

-- Sets the speed bounds when either bound moved. The two numbers are cached as they are, so a tick builds neither a
-- string to compare them nor a closure to send them.
local function set_bounds(u, floor, cap)
  local rec = applied[u]
  if not rec then rec = {}; applied[u] = rec end
  if rec.floor == floor and rec.cap == cap then return end
  rec.floor = floor
  rec.cap = cap
  game.set_speed_bounds(u, floor, cap)
end

return {
  on_tick = function(state)
    for _, u in ipairs(game.units(nil)) do
      set_once(u, "armour", armour_scale(game.armour_of(u)), game.set_armour_scale)
      set_once(u, "magic", magic_keep(u), game.set_magic_keep)
      set_once(u, "damage", damage_keep(u), game.set_damage_keep)
      set_once(u, "response", response_keep(u), game.set_response_keep)
      local floor, cap = speed_bounds(u)
      set_bounds(u, floor, cap)
      -- The shot's reach decides whether it can miss: a melee weapon's shots never do.
      local _, range = game.weapon(u)
      set_once(u, "miss", range <= MELEE and 0 or game.unit_miss_chance(u), game.set_miss_chance)
    end
  end,
}
